primary_recommendation: 显式标识(Visible Mark):画面叠加可被人眼识别的 AI 来源标识,播放全程持续可见。
rationale: 网信办令第17号(2025-09-01):文字'AI 生成'或图标+文字组合;纯图标不合规。
source_section: AI 标识办法/显式标识

primary_recommendation: 隐式标识(Metadata):嵌入文件元数据的不可见标识,C2PA/Content Credentials 风格,可被平台机器读。
rationale: digi:source 必须为 'AI-generated' 或 'AI-assisted';provenance 链记录每道工序;ai_disclosure_present 与显式标识一致。
source_section: AI 标识办法/隐式标识

primary_recommendation: 文本披露(Script Disclosure):节目正文中以语音或字幕明确告知含 AI 生成成分。
rationale: 含 AI 生成角色面部/语音/背景的节目必须≥1 处文本披露;字号≥字幕条 80%,停留≥2 秒。

templates.cold-open: 本作品由 AI 辅助生成,部分画面与声音经过人工智能处理
templates.end-card: 本作品由 <出品方> 联合 AI 创作工具制作,生成式 AI 使用情况已备案

source_section: AI 标识办法/文本披露

primary_recommendation: AI 漫剧备案触发矩阵(2026-04-01):按内容类型 × 集数 × 时长 × 商业意图触发,宁多备不漏备。
rationale: 全 AIG 阈值最低(≥3 集/≥15 分钟/任何分发→重点备案);互动剧≥1 集即重点备案+未成年人保护评估。

primary_recommendation: AIGC Labeling Workflow:7 步标准流程(判定范围→显式标识→隐式标识→文本披露→备案检查→政治敏感过审→归档)。
rationale: 每步按序执行,任一步缺失即不合规;归档保留期≥节目下架后 2 年。

rationale: 算法偏好高密度 + 移动端注意力衰减快。小程序剧长集可 2-2.5s。

primary_recommendation: 3-Second Dead Air Rule: 不允许 >3s 死寂镜头 (无对白/动作/BGM 推进)。
rationale: 移动端退出成本低，3s 死寂触发上滑。纯静态镜头 >3s 永远违规无例外。

Action — Explosion: burst, pop, boom, detonate。Intensity modifier:sharp/dull/heavy/light。
Environment — Open outdoor: no reflections, distant echoes。Keywords: open field / distant mountain echo。
Environment — Small room: short reverb (~200ms)。Keywords: small bedroom / tight reverb。
Environment — Large hall: long reverb (1-3s)。Keywords: cathedral / concert hall。
Environment — Industrial: metallic ringing。Keywords: factory floor / metallic resonance。
Environment — Vehicle interior: confined, low-frequency rumble。Keywords: car interior / low rumble floor。
Proximity — Close-up (intimate): keywords 'close-up / intimate / in-ear',mix level -3 to 0 dB。
Proximity — Near (present): keywords 'near / present',mix level -6 to -3 dB。
Proximity — Mid (normal): keywords '(default, no qualifier)',mix level -12 to -6 dB。
Proximity — Far (distant): keywords 'distant / far away',mix level -18 to -12 dB。
Proximity — Background (ambient): keywords 'background / ambient',mix level -24 to -18 dB。
Temporal — Instantaneous: <100ms attack + immediate decay。Keywords: sharp / instantaneous / staccato。
Temporal — Sustained: Long hold with gradual decay。Keywords: sustained / drone。
Temporal — Crescendo: Builds in intensity。Keywords: crescendo / building。
Temporal — Decrescendo: Fades from intensity。Keywords: fading / decrescendo。
Temporal — Pulse: Rhythmic repetition。Keywords: pulsing / rhythmic。

Dim1 情节点密度(8pts):plot_point_density=key_plot_points/total_scenes。Hit≥0.40,miss<0.20;≥0.45→8分。
Dim1 三幕适配(6pts):理想 Setup25%/Confrontation50%/Resolution25%。偏差≤5%→6分;>20%偏差→-3/act。Setup>35%=长前导 anti-pattern。
Dim1 节奏变化(6pts):rhythm_stddev=相邻场景冲突强度标准差(1-10尺度)。Hit≥2.0,miss<1.0;≥2.5→6分。
Dim2 极性跨度(7pts):range=max(valence)-min(valence)。Hit≥1.4,miss<0.6;≥1.6→7分。
Dim2 转场频率(7pts):|Δvalence|≥0.3 或 primary class 变化的转场/分钟。短剧比微电影高1.5-2×。Hit≥5.0/min,miss<2.0;≥6.0→7分。

type=string, owner=human, format=`char_<short_id>` (lowercase alphanumeric, ≤20 chars after prefix)。人工给定，AI 不可自主生成；缺失时阻塞输出。
rationale: 全生产 DAG 的 join key，所有 expert 共用；创建后 Frozen，永不改变。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=human。角色显示名，须人工给定；可编辑（display name 可变）。
rationale: 角色名是 human-owner 字段，但非 frozen，可在 revision 中修改显示名。

primary_recommendation: type=string (natural language), owner=shared。须覆盖 age+gender+hair+eyes+face+outfit+accessories+height/build；长度 100-300 chars。锁定后 FROZEN。
rationale: 人工给方向/wardrobe budget，AI 扩写物理细节；下游 drawer 生成图像、continuity 做视觉参考。属 frozen_fields 契约。

primary_recommendation: type=object，结构化三层分类（core/external/narrative），owner=shared。v2.1 升级自 v2.0 扁平 string，下游 screenplay/continuity/performance 消费。
rationale: Notion 第四场人物设计圆桌方法论：扁平 string 无法按维度精准匹配台词；结构化 object 让 screenplay 读 language_profile、continuity 读 core 行为基线+arc。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=human。性格底色（冷静/暴躁/隐忍/直爽…）。角色的灵魂锚点之一，须人工（导演/编剧）锁定。
rationale: 决定角色'是谁'；一旦人工锁定倾向稳定，但非 frozen（可在 revision 调整）。是 daily_life 反差萌与 counterpoint 张力的对照基线。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=human。核心驱动力（wants/needs）——驱动表面行为的动力。须人工锁定。
rationale: 驱动角色行为；由 wound 深层创伤驱动。human-owner 灵魂锚点，AI 不得猜测填充。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=human。未愈合的心理伤口，驱动 motivation 的深层创伤。须人工锁定。
rationale: v2.1 新增字段；动机的根源。是弧光转化能量的来源。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=human。角色信奉的人生信条（可对可错，但角色深信）。须人工锁定。
rationale: v2.1 新增字段；决定角色在冲突中的抉择逻辑。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=ai。日常底色（日常状态/温暖面/反差萌/情绪反差基础），由 AI 从 core 推导。必须覆盖日常状态+至少一个反差萌特质+反差铺垫。
rationale: 让角色'活'起来而非只是'待解决的伤口'；先有日常的暖，冲突的痛才更痛。是后续情绪落差的反差基础。

primary_recommendation: type=object, owner=ai。语言画像，screenplay 台词匹配的硬性输入（遮挡角色名仍能辨识说话人）+分级潜台词依据。必须覆盖 5 个子字段。
rationale: 隐忍型→高潜台词、直爽型→低潜台词；由 AI 从 core 推导。下游 continuity 可标注 drift。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=ai。口癖/口头禅（如'无所谓'、'我说真的'）。
rationale: language_profile 必须全覆盖的 5 子字段之一；台词辨识度锚点。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=ai。句式偏好（长句/短句/感叹/反问/倒装）。
rationale: language_profile 5 子字段之一；影响台词节奏与潜台词分级。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=ai。用词特征（书面/口语/方言/行业术语/粗口倾向）。
rationale: language_profile 5 子字段之一；社会阶层与教育背景的台词投射。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=ai。语言节奏（快/慢/顿挫/滔滔不绝）。
rationale: language_profile 5 子字段之一；表演节奏与剪辑节奏的依据。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=ai。语言软肋（激动时结巴/撒谎时语速变快/紧张时重复词…）。
rationale: language_profile 5 子字段之一；泄露真实情绪的台词微特征，continuity/performance 关注。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=ai。社会阶层+职业身份，由 AI 从 core+appearance 推导。
rationale: 影响用词、认知方式与人际模式（v2.0 旧 interpersonal_style 内容并入 mannerisms 与 relationships）。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=ai。教育背景（影响用词和认知方式）。
rationale: 由 AI 推导；决定 vocabulary 层次与认知框架。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=ai。家庭背景（影响人际模式和安全感来源）。
rationale: 由 AI 推导；与 wound 和 relationships 联动。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=ai。声音特征（音色/语速/音量/特殊习惯音）。
rationale: 由 AI 推导；下游 lip_sync 与 performer 消费。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=ai。行为举止习惯（肢体语言/微表情/习惯动作）。
rationale: v2.0 旧 interpersonal_style 内容并入此处；performance 与 continuity 行为基线参考。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=shared。角色在故事中的叙事功能（主角/对手/镜像/催化剂…），与导演共定。
rationale: 决定角色在剧情结构中的位置与戏份权重。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=shared。角色弧光（从什么→到什么的转变轨迹），与导演共定。
rationale: continuity_auditor 检测角色行为是否偏离弧光；counterpoint 是弧光转化的潜在能量。

primary_recommendation: type=array, owner=shared。与其他角色的关系网络，每条标注关系类型。
rationale: v2.0 旧 interpersonal_style 的人际部分并入此处；screenplay 关系戏与 continuity 一致性参考。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=shared。反差特质（必填，nullable=false）——与核心性格矛盾的正向特质：冷酷角色的柔软角落/直爽角色的隐忍时刻/隐忍角色的爆发阈值。
rationale: Notion 关键洞察：反差特质是角色灵魂不是装饰。validation 强制检查存在与具体性（非空非泛化）。必须与 core.temperament 形成可被叙事利用的张力，既是 daily_life 反差萌的叙事锚点也是 arc 转化能量。

primary_recommendation: 约束：角色的性格/创伤/动机/设定禁止由角色自己解说（'我是一个...的人'），必须通过行为和冲突自然交代。personality 是写给作者/screenplay/continuity 的内部契约，绝不允许泄露成角色自述台词。

primary_recommendation: 每角色定义 4 个规范视角（front 0°/three_quarter 45°/side 90°/back 180°），各自有专属 prompt 模板与使用优先级。无 4D 锚点则下游 drawer/animator/lip_sync 无法保持跨镜头身份。

primary_recommendation: front-source.png，yaw 0°。身份基线，用于正面镜头、表情参考、lip_sync 参考。prompt 关键词: 'front view, eyes looking at camera, symmetrical composition, neutral expression'。
rationale: ArcFace 在正面脸表现最佳，故 continuity ArcFace 基线用 front；lip_sync 需正面嘴部可见性故以 front 为主。

primary_recommendation: 3q-source.png，yaw 45°。最常用角度，多数镜头默认。prompt: '3/4 view, head turned 45 degrees, showing depth and volume, partial side visibility'。
rationale: 自然深度+部分面部，是 stress test 的主参考（3Q anchor）；Seedance 双参考默认 [three_quarter, front] 之首。
source_section: The 4 anchor views + View priority order

primary_recommendation: side-source.png，yaw 90°。剪影锚点，用于 profile 镜头、walking-away 镜头。prompt: 'side profile, clean outline, nose bridge and jawline, full body visible'。
rationale: 严格 90° profile；front vs side ArcFace ≥0.75。

primary_recommendation: back-source.png，yaw 180°。背影构图，用于 walking-away 揭示。prompt: 'back view, full body, hair and outfit back details, no face visible'。
rationale: 短剧常用 '角色离开冲突' 揭示镜头；3 视角方案缺失此角度。

primary_recommendation: 下游选参考的优先级：1) three_quarter（多数镜头默认）2) front（需全脸:情感特写/对话）3) side（profile/walking-away）4) back（背影构图）。Seedance 双参考默认 [three_quarter, front]+场景锚点第3参考；lip_sync 以 front 为主 three_quarter 兜底；continuity ArcFace 用 front。
rationale: 按镜头类型匹配最佳身份参考视角。

primary_recommendation: 跨视角可接受漂移预算：CLIP-I 同视角重生 ≥0.92、跨视角 0.80-0.90；DINO-I 同视角 ≥0.90、跨视角 0.78-0.88；ArcFace front vs 3Q ≥0.85、front vs side ≥0.75。跨视角 CLIP-I >0.95 可疑（模型可能坍缩到单一规范视角）。
rationale: 严格 STYLE_PREFIX 下不同角度天然展示不同特征，故跨视角预算低于同视角；>0.95 反而可疑。

primary_recommendation: 每锚点集验证：1) vision_analyze 转面图确认 4 视角同一人（rating ≥7/10）2) 算 6 对 CLIP-I 3) 算 6 对 DINO-I 4) 通过阈值：所有 6 对 CLIP-I ≥0.80 且所有 6 对 DINO-I ≥0.78 5) 任一对低于阈值→重生整张转面图（Method A）或失败视角（Method B）。
rationale: Method A 单图转面天然一致；Method B 逐视角生成 CLIP-I 跨视角常低于 0.80。
source_section: Anchor style consistency enforcement / Verification protocol

primary_recommendation: 每个测试场景生成图与 3Q anchor 的 CLIP 图像嵌入余弦相似度。通过阈值 CLIP-I ≥0.80。
rationale: 0.80 处于'同人不同场景'上区：高于 0.85 拒绝合法场景诱导方差，低于 0.70 接受漂移。

primary_recommendation: 3 场景 CLIP-I 均值。通过阈值均值 ≥0.82；distinct identity 阈值均值 ≥0.85（角色稳健一致）。
rationale: 跨场景聚合验证整体一致性；≥0.85 标志身份强健。

primary_recommendation: 每场景生成图与 3Q anchor 的 DINO 自监督嵌入余弦相似度。通过阈值 DINO-I ≥0.78。
rationale: DINO 聚焦形状/结构（vs CLIP 聚焦语义+风格），两者交叉验证。

primary_recommendation: 3 场景 DINO-I 均值。通过阈值均值 ≥0.80。
rationale: 结构一致性的跨场景聚合。

primary_recommendation: 经验校准带：同人同场景重生 0.90-0.95；同人不同合理场景 0.75-0.88；不同人同风格 0.55-0.70；不同人不同风格 0.30-0.50。
rationale: 为阈值选型提供经验依据；0.80 落在'同人不同场景'上区。

primary_recommendation: 锚点集所有 6 对 CLIP-I（4 视角两两）。通过阈值：所有 6 对 ≥0.80。
rationale: 锚点级身份一致性闸门（stress test 前置）。

primary_recommendation: 锚点集所有 6 对 DINO-I。通过阈值：所有 6 对 ≥0.78。
rationale: 锚点级结构一致性。

primary_recommendation: front 与 three_quarter 锚点的 ArcFace 余弦相似度。通过阈值 ≥0.85。
rationale: ArcFace 在正面脸最佳；front vs 3Q 应高度相似。

primary_recommendation: front 与 side 锚点的 ArcFace 余弦相似度。通过阈值 ≥0.75。
rationale: side profile ArcFace 分数天然较低，阈值放宽。

primary_recommendation: 同视角重生（regen same view）CLIP-I ≥0.92；跨视角 CLIP-I 区间 0.80-0.90。
rationale: 同视角应高度相似；跨视角天然较低。

primary_recommendation: 同视角重生 DINO-I ≥0.90；跨视角 DINO-I 区间 0.78-0.88。
rationale: 结构相似性同/跨视角带。

primary_recommendation: 跨角色区分度：若所有 3 场景通过但跨角色 CLIP-I >0.70，角色区分不足。修复：给 STYLE_IDENTITY 加差异化特征。
rationale: 同风格不同角色 CLIP-I 经验带 0.55-0.70；>0.70 说明角色过于相似。

primary_recommendation: strength 参数三档：0.30-0.40 低锁高姿态自由（动作/动态）；0.40-0.50 中锁平衡（多数场景默认）；0.50-0.60 高锁低姿态自由（面部特写/肖像）。3 测试场景用极值 0.35/0.40/0.55 覆盖该范围。
rationale: 确保角色在低/高 strength 两端都能保持。

primary_recommendation: Layer 1 STYLE_CORE：全局（项目所有角色），来自 style_genome。style_genome 输出后 frozen。示例: 'anime, cyberpunk era, cinematic lighting'。长度 20-50 tokens。
rationale: 全局风格基线；改需重跑 style_genome+版本 bump+级联所有角色 character_designer revision。跳过或模糊则 CORE 漂向 drawer 训练分布（千人一面同题材）。

extra_data.example: anime, cyberpunk era, cinematic lighting

primary_recommendation: Layer 2 STYLE_IDENTITY：每角色，来自 character_designer。通过 stress test 后 frozen。须具体（≥5 physical features），长度 50-150 tokens。示例: 'black long hair, red eyes, scar on left cheek, black trench coat'。
rationale: 模糊 identity（'cool guy with dark hair'）→下游 drift；具体 identity（'25yo male, shoulder-length black hair... 3cm scar'）→锁定身份。physical/outfit/accessories(if locked)/distinguishing marks 全部 frozen。

extra_data.example: black long hair, red eyes, scar on left cheek, black trench coat

primary_recommendation: Layer 3 STYLE_VARIANCE：每镜头/每场景，下游调用时填充。模板 '{lighting}, {weather}, {mood}'，长度 5-30 tokens/次替换。是角色锁后唯一可变层。
rationale: 允许场景变化同时不破坏身份。约束：不得与 IDENTITY 冲突（如 IDENTITY 黑发则 VARIANCE 不可写金发）、不得与 CORE 冲突、单场景内一致。

extra_data.example: {lighting}, {weather}, {mood}

primary_recommendation: 组合公式（每个下游 prompt）：'{STYLE_CORE}, {STYLE_IDENTITY}, {STYLE_VARIANCE}'。锁定后 style_prefix_locked 为此三层机械组合（VARIANCE 为字面占位符）。
rationale: 三层正交：CORE 全局、IDENTITY 角色、VARIANCE 场景；机械组合保证一致性。

primary_recommendation: STYLE_CORE 必填子字段：genre（题材 cyberpunk/wuxia/romance/horror）、era（时代 contemporary/medieval/future）、mood（全局美学 cinematic/anime/realistic）、lighting style（高调/低调/混合）。
rationale: style_genome 须输出这些子字段才算有效 CORE。

primary_recommendation: STYLE_IDENTITY 必填子字段：physical（发色/长度/发型、眼色/形状、脸型/颧骨/疤痕等）、outfit（主服色/款、次服、鞋）、accessories（默认配饰，仅常驻）、distinguishing marks（疤/纹身/胎记）。
rationale: 具体子字段保证 identity 可锁定、可审计。

primary_recommendation: 每角色 positive_prompt='{STYLE_PREFIX}, {scene_addons}'，negative_prompt='{negative_traits}, {general_negatives}'。negative_traits 须镜像该 demographic 每个默认漂移倾向，否则模型回退训练默认。
rationale: STYLE_PREFIX 定义角色'是什么'，negative prompt 定义'不是什么'；两者皆需。

primary_recommendation: 推荐方法：用 dreamina image2image 从 front 参考生成 ONE 张含 4 视角的转面图（16:9, 2k, model 5.0Pro），再 ffmpeg 裁成 4 个锚点。Volvo 验证一致性 8-9/10 vs 逐视角 2-3/10。
rationale: 模型单次推理画 4 视角，身份（脸型/肤色/发/装）共享同一 latent space；逐视角生成每次重采样身份致 drift。

primary_recommendation: 遗留方法 B：每视角单独 dreamina t2i/i2i 生成。已知问题：跨视角身份漂移，CLIP-I 跨视角对常低于 0.80。仅在 Method A 失败时用，且必须跑验证协议并重生失败视角。
rationale: 每次生成重采样身份；不推荐。

primary_recommendation: 16:9 横排 1×4（2560×1440，4列）裁切：crop=iw/4:ih:iw*N/4:0，N=0..3 对应 front/3q/side/back。
rationale: 确定性后处理（无 LLM）；按列等分裁切。

primary_recommendation: 9:16 竖屏 2×2 四宫格裁切（1440×2560，2行×2列）：左上 front / 右上 3q / 左下 side / 右下 back，crop=iw/2:ih/2:{0 or iw/2}:{0 or ih/2}。
rationale: 竖屏短剧默认形态；确定性裁切。

primary_recommendation: 竖屏剧集：始终先 16:9 横排 4 列生成（dreamina 最可靠全身材格式），再后处理 crop→stack→resize 成竖排 2×2（height=2560, 1440px canvas 居中）。Landscape 剧集跳过后处理直接消费 16:9。2026-08-03《她从深渊归来》验证。
rationale: dreamina 直接生成 9:16 2×2 不可靠（角色常被截到腰部'缺腿' bug）；恒 16:9 生成+竖屏后处理稳定全身材。方向不匹配会令 LiconMSR IC-LoRA 身份条件化失效。

primary_recommendation: Tier 0 基础身份转面（紧身衣 bodysuit，灰色，非场景服装）：text2image 生 front 参考→image2image 生转面图。锁脸+体型于中性服装无关态。1×4 横排（16:9, 2560×1440），列: 面部特写/front/side profile/back。输出 turnaround_sheets/base_{char_id}.png。
rationale: LiconMSR 优化：旧 2-tier 给 LiconMSR 单视角参考图欠佳；先锁裸身份护照再穿装。角色须立身站立 full-body neutral pose。

primary_recommendation: Tier 1 场景定妆转面：image2image 从 Tier 0 整张 base 转面图（非裁切单视角）生成角色穿场景服装的转面图。每 (character×scene) 一对生成一张。参考图须是整张 Tier 0 转面以保证 4 视角身份连贯。
rationale: LiconMSR 实际参考此 Tier 1 表；用整张 Tier 0 表（非 crop）保证跨视角身份连贯。

extra_data.ref_source: entire Tier 0 base turnaround sheet (not crop)

primary_recommendation: Tier 2 LiconMSR 参考分配：Node 40 参考槽接收整张 Tier 1 场景服装转面表（full multi-view sheet，非裁切单视角）。shot-list refs 格式：[char_s costume turnaround, 第二角色 turnaround, 背景 scene 图]。裁切步骤已移除——LiconMSR 接收 full sheet。
rationale: LiconMSR 的 IC-LoRA 训练于多视角参考表，喂同格式给推理时更丰富身份条件化，模型可在单参考槽内交叉引用 front/side/back。ArcFace 若实现可现场从 column 1 裁脸。

extra_data.ref_source: Tier 1 full scene costume turnaround sheet

primary_recommendation: 生成后用 vision_analyze 验证跨视角一致性：问 'Are all 4 views clearly the SAME person? Check face shape, hair, skin tone, clothing. Rate consistency 1-10.' 可接受 ≥7/10；<7 重生（在 prompt 显式重复 identity 特征）。
rationale: 客观一致性 + 视觉抽检互补。

primary_recommendation: CLIP-I Low + DINO-I Low：整体身份漂移。修复：重新生成变体。
rationale: 语义/风格与形状/结构双失败，说明身份根本未确立。

primary_recommendation: Snowflake-4 段落 1(开头)→ Snyder beats: Opening Image + Theme Stated + Set-Up + Catalyst + Debate;目标 runtime 0-20%。段落结尾(Catalyst)必须对齐 Snyder Catalyst(~10%)。
rationale: Snowflake-4 → Snyder 15-Beat 字段映射。段落 1 介绍主人公世界+触发事件。强制对齐锚点之一:段落 1 结尾的 Catalyst 落在 p.10±3(~10% runtime,±5% 容差)。

primary_recommendation: Snowflake-4 段落 2(三幕灾难 第 1 幕)→ Snyder beats: Break into Two + B-Story + Fun & Games + Midpoint;目标 runtime 20-50%。段落结尾(Midpoint)必须有极性反转,对齐 Snyder Midpoint(~50%)。
rationale: 段落 2 = 主角进入新世界+假胜利/假失败。强制对齐锚点:段落 2 结尾 Midpoint 落在 p.55±3(~50% runtime,且必须有极性反转,±5% 容差)。

extra_data.anchor: Midpoint ~50% (p.55 ± 3), must have polarity reversal, ±5% tolerance

primary_recommendation: Snowflake-4 段落 3(三幕灾难 第 2 幕)→ Snyder beats: Bad Guys Close In + All Is Lost + Dark Night of the Soul;目标 runtime 50-77%。段落结尾(All Is Lost)对齐 Snyder All Is Lost(~68%)。
rationale: 段落 3 = 外部对手反扑+最低点。强制对齐锚点:段落 3 结尾 All Is Lost 落在 p.75±3(~68% runtime,±5% 容差)。

primary_recommendation: Snowflake-4 段落 4(结尾)→ Snyder beats: Break into Three + Finale + Final Image;目标 runtime 77-100%。主角找到解决方案+执行+视觉对照。
rationale: 段落 4 = 主角找到解决方案+执行+视觉对照。无强制锚点(前三段已锁三锚点)。

primary_recommendation: Snowflake 展开触发条件(三选一,默认不展开): unspeakability_score≥7,或 dramatic_potential.overall≥0.75,或 strata_overlay_coefficient≥1.7。满足任一即必须走雪花法展开;否则 snowflake_artifacts 字段为 null 直接交付 screenplay。
rationale: 决定一个 StoryKernel 是否值得走雪花法展开。高敏感 kernel 需更精细角色/场景设计承载合规降级;高潜力 kernel 值得展开为完整叙事 scaffold;多层叠加 kernel 需角色层面承接多冲突维度。trigger_reason 必须三选一。

primary_recommendation: kernel_id: string,格式 kernel_<8-char-hash>(由 structural_formula + created_at 确定性生成),创建时冻结,是所有下游消费者的 join key。
rationale: StoryKernel 的唯一标识。Frozen at creation。所有下游 expert 通过 kernel_id 关联。

extra_data.constraint: deterministic from structural_formula + created_at; frozen at creation; join key for all downstream consumers

primary_recommendation: strata_layers (array, REQUIRED): 1-3 个地层条目(4+ 不鼓励),每条含 layer(L1-L6)/layer_name/analysis/evidence_sources[]/structural_question/answer。每个条目必须有 ≥1 条 evidence_sources。
rationale: StoryKernel 的结构力来源。每条 evidence_sources 含 source/url/accessed_date/evidence_strength(high|medium|low)。VETO 条件之一:strata_layers.length≥4 = 叙事过载。

extra_data.constraint: 1-3 entries; each layer in L1-L6; each entry requires >=1 evidence_sources; required sub-fields: layer, layer_name, analysis, evidence_sources[], structural_question, answer

primary_recommendation: structural_formula (REQUIRED): 50-200 字单句,描述不可约的结构性冲突;一旦被下游消费即冻结。必须包含至少 1 个结构力(L1-L5)且至少 1 个人文后果。
rationale: StoryKernel 的统一主题,被 screenplay/style_genome 消费。验证:单句 50-200 字,含结构力+人文后果。反例:现代社会让人很焦虑(太抽象)/灵活就业者的故事(无结构冲突)。

extra_data.constraint: 50-200 chars, single sentence; must contain >=1 structural force (L1-L5) AND >=1 human consequence; frozen once consumed downstream

primary_recommendation: strata_overlay_coefficient: float 1.0-3.0,默认 1.0(单层);由地层组合计算而来,不可直接编辑。来源见 multi-strata-resonance.md 矩阵。
rationale: 反映多层叠加共振强度。2-layer 最高 1.8(L1+L4),3-layer 因果链可达 2.5(L1+L2+L4)。校验:系数必须与 layer 组合匹配。

extra_data.constraint: range 1.0-3.0; default 1.0 (single layer); computed from layer combination, not directly editable; must match layer combination per multi-strata-resonance.md

primary_recommendation: unspeakability_breakdown: object,4 个必填子字段 political_sensitivity/platform_algorithm_risk/audience_discomfort/regulatory_redline(各 1-10);聚合 unspeakability_score = round(0.20*P + 0.30*A + 0.15*D + 0.35*R)。
rationale: 聚合分权重 0.20/0.30/0.15/0.35。compliance_marketing 下游消费以识别风险维度。VETO 条件之一:unspeakability_score≥9。

extra_data.constraint: 4 required sub-fields each 1-10; aggregate = round(0.20*political + 0.30*platform + 0.15*audience + 0.35*regulatory); veto if aggregate >= 9

primary_recommendation: dramatic_potential: object,3 个 0.0-1.0 子字段 actionability/emotional_intensity/narrative_compression_fit,及 overall;overall = actionability*0.40 + emotional_intensity*0.35 + narrative_compression_fit*0.25。
rationale: 衡量戏剧化潜力。actionability=多容易转化为具体场景;emotional_intensity=观众情绪反应强度;narrative_compression_fit=多适合短剧 60-180s 格式。VETO 条件之一:overall<0.40(太弱无法戏剧化)。

primary_recommendation: target_audience_overlap: object,6 个必填 0.0-1.0 人口分段 male_18_25/male_25_35/male_35_50/female_18_25/female_25_35/female_35_50。VETO 条件之一:max<0.50(无明确受众)。
rationale: 描述受众重叠度,被 style_genome 消费以决定 genre/mood。校验:6 个分段必须全填。VETO:最大分段<0.50 = 无清晰受众。

extra_data.constraint: 6 required segments each 0.0-1.0 (male_18_25, male_25_35, male_35_50, female_18_25, female_25_35, female_35_50); veto if max < 0.50

primary_recommendation: platform_compliance_paths: object,以平台名为键、合规策略描述为值;CN 必填键 douyin/kuaishou/xiaohongshu/wechat_mini;可选 bilibili/youtube_shorts/tiktok_us。
rationale: compliance_marketing 下游消费以制定分发策略。每个 CN 平台有不同容忍度(抖音 1-5 谨慎 / 快手 1-6 / 小红书 1-6 / 微信小程序 1-7 tolerant / B站 1-6 / 视频号 1-5)。

extra_data.constraint: required CN keys: douyin, kuaishou, xiaohongshu, wechat_mini; optional: bilibili, youtube_shorts, tiktok_us

primary_recommendation: evidence_strength_aggregate: enum high/medium-high/medium/low/none,由 strata_layers[].evidence_sources[].evidence_strength 聚合。VETO 条件之一:= none(无数据源、纯推测)。
rationale: 聚合规则:全 high→high;high+medium 混合→medium-high;全 medium→medium;任一 low→low;evidence_sources 为空→none(降级模式)。

primary_recommendation: 主光 (Key light) 位于 camera 左/右 30-45°、高于主体 30-45°,强度为 100%(reference),作为主要光源塑造主体形态。
rationale: 经典 3-point lighting 标准的主光位置与强度,per Alton《Painting with Light》(1949)。是整个 lighting setup 的 reference 基准,fill 与 back 均以 key 强度为参照。

extra_data.position: camera 左/右 30-45°, 高于主体 30-45°

primary_recommendation: 补光 (Fill light) 位于 camera 对侧、与 key 同高度,强度为 key 的 30-50%,用于填充 key 产生的 shadow。
rationale: 3-point lighting 的补光位与强度,per Alton(1949)。Key-to-fill ratio 即由此 30-50% 比例衍生,决定 dramatic intensity。

extra_data.position: camera 对侧, 与 key 同高度

primary_recommendation: 背光 / 轮廓光 (Back / Rim light) 位于主体后方、高于主体 45-60°,强度为 key 的 50-100%,用于分离主体与 backdrop 并 highlight 主体轮廓。
rationale: 3-point lighting 的背光位与强度,per Alton(1949)。提供主体与背景的 depth 分离。

extra_data.position: 主体后方, 高于主体 45-60°

primary_recommendation: Comedy / 女频 romance:key-to-fill ratio 2:1,主光 warm 3200K,back light 为 soft rim;短剧修正为高调 + 柔光。
rationale: Per-genre lighting 协议表。高调低对比适配喜剧与女频 romance 的明亮基调;fill_ratio 0.5 由 2:1 ratio 衍生。

primary_recommendation: Drama / 文艺:key-to-fill ratio 4:1,主光 natural 5600K,back light 为 standard rim;短剧修正为中等 + 自然光。
rationale: Per-genre lighting 协议表。中等对比为标准剧情的标准强度;fill_ratio 0.25 由 4:1 ratio 衍生。

primary_recommendation: Thriller / 男频 revenge:key-to-fill ratio 8:1+,主光 cool 3200K + warm practical,back light 为 hard rim;短剧修正为低调 + 高对比。
rationale: Per-genre lighting 协议表。高对比营造悬疑与复仇戏剧张力;fill_ratio 0.125 由 8:1 ratio 衍生。注意 doc 原文标注 'cool 3200K + warm practical'。

primary_recommendation: Horror:key-to-fill ratio 16:1+,主光 cool 4200K from below,back light 为 minimal;短剧修正为极低调 + 红色 wash。
rationale: Per-genre lighting 协议表。极低调与自下而上的光源营造 horror 感;fill_ratio 0.0625 由 16:1 ratio 衍生。

primary_recommendation: Documentary / 现实主义:natural key-to-fill ratio,主光 natural 5600K,back light 为 ambient;短剧修正为自然光 + minimal setup。
rationale: Per-genre lighting 协议表。现实主义倾向自然光与极简布置,故 ratio 标为 natural 不强制数值。

primary_recommendation: Music video / 实验:variable key-to-fill ratio,colored 主光,colored back light;短剧修正为 stylized。
rationale: Per-genre lighting 协议表。实验性内容采用可变 ratio 与彩色光,需注意 colored light over-saturation(见 anti-pattern 3)。

primary_recommendation: Low ratio (2:1):高调 / 明亮 / 喜剧 / 女频 romance。
rationale: Key-to-fill ratio 决定 dramatic intensity 的第一档;fill_ratio 0.5 由 2:1 衍生。

primary_recommendation: Medium ratio (4:1):中等 / 标准剧情。
rationale: Key-to-fill ratio 第二档;fill_ratio 0.25 由 4:1 衍生。

primary_recommendation: High ratio (8:1+):低调 / 戏剧 / 黑色 / 悬疑 / 男频 revenge。
rationale: Key-to-fill ratio 第三档;fill_ratio 0.125 由 8:1 衍生。

primary_recommendation: Very high ratio (16:1+):极低调 / 黑色电影 / horror。
rationale: Key-to-fill ratio 第四档;fill_ratio 0.0625 由 16:1 衍生。

primary_recommendation: Provider-agnostic abstract prompt built from five sections — [identity], [composition], [motion], [lighting], [mood]. It captures the intent of the prompt without committing to any model's grammar, e.g. [identity] char_wuji, male, 30s, gaunt cheekbones, rain-soaked coat / [composition] medium close-up, eye-line left-of-frame, shallow DoF / [motion] static held beat, micro-tremor in jaw / [lighting] key: amber sodium-vapor practical from frame-left / [mood] oppressive humidity, moral rot barely concealed.
rationale: Layer 1 of the provider-agnostic abstraction layer: this abstract structure is stable across model swaps. A thin per-model adapter maps it to model grammar (Layer 2), so swapping <image_primary>/<video_primary> requires only an adapter change, not an abstract-prompt rewrite.

adapter_examples: Veo adapter: Camera: ... Subject: ... Lighting: ... Mood: ...

primary_recommendation: dreamina (即梦/jimeng-5.0) uses a natural-language dominant grammar with optional structured tags: [character: <identity description>] [composition: <framing description>] [lighting: <lighting setup>] followed by a <mood sentence in natural language>. Natural-language sentences carry most of the visual information; structured tags anchor specific concerns.
rationale: dreamina is the mandated <image_primary> (FLUX 2 is PROHIBITED per 2026-07-28 directive). 9:16 vertical is supported natively for 短剧 format. Cross-ref visual_executor/drawer/dreamina-image-generation-execution.md for CLI deep-dive.

extra_data.example: [character: char_wuji, male, 30s, gaunt cheekbones, rain-soaked dark wool coat, five-o-clock shadow] [composition: medium close-up, eye-line left-of-frame, shallow depth of field, 9:16 vertical] [lighting: key: amber sodium-vapor practical from frame-left, fill: cool blue bounce from frame-right, low-key ratio 4:1] The air is thick with humidity and moral rot; char_wuji's jaw trembles almost imperceptibly as he holds the beat.

primary_recommendation: Veo 2 uses cinematographic descriptor prefixes. Each sentence begins with a category prefix followed by natural-language description: 'Camera: <camera move + speed + ease>. Subject: <identity + action>. Lighting: <lighting setup>. Mood: <emotional tone>.'
rationale: verified_date 2026-06 (Google DeepMind Veo 2 technical report + prompt guide). Camera descriptors pan/tilt/dolly/tracking/crane/static/orbit each take speed (0.0-1.0) and ease (linear/ease_in/ease_out/ease_in_out). Duration 4-8s per clip (concatenate for longer). 9:16 supported. Veo 2 does NOT generate audio — pair with audio_pipeline.

primary_recommendation: Seedance 2.0 Director Formula: 'Subject + Action + Scene + Camera + Lighting/Style + Audio + Constraints'. Each element serves one intention (the shot's felt_intent); the prompt reads as a coherent director's instruction, not a tag list. Prompts are compiled from project state (clip contract + observed state + continuity locks), not written from scratch each call.
rationale: verified_date 2026-07 (Seedance 2.0 Skill OS v6.6.0). Closer to a shooting brief than structured tags — the key difference from FLUX/Veo/Kling. Prompt budget ~1000 chars (surface-specific; verify live). Duration 5-15s per clip. Native audio generation supported (ambience, SFX, dialogue).

primary_recommendation: Seedance T2V mode: build the whole shot in compact layers. Key constraint — one visible beat, one endpoint.
rationale: T2V (text-to-video) is for building the whole shot from text alone; the prompt must commit to a single visible beat and a single endpoint to keep the clip coherent.

primary_recommendation: Seedance I2V mode: preserve @Image1 identity; add only motion. Say 'preserve @Image1 exactly'; do not re-describe the identity that the reference already defines.
rationale: I2V (image-to-video) anchors identity to @Image1; re-describing identity in prose both wastes tokens and risks contradicting the reference. State the preserve instruction explicitly.

primary_recommendation: Seedance V2V mode: transfer motion/camera/timing from @Video1. Restrict the transfer role explicitly so only the intended layer (motion, camera, or timing) is copied.
rationale: V2V (video-to-video) pulls motion/camera/timing from a reference clip; without an explicit role restriction the model may copy unwanted elements (identity, logo, scene ownership).

primary_recommendation: Seedance R2V mode: assign separate roles to each reference (e.g. @Image1 = identity, @Video1 = motion, @Audio1 = mood). One reference must not carry incompatible roles.
rationale: R2V (reference-to-video, multi-reference) lets each uploaded asset serve a distinct role; assigning conflicting roles to a single reference confuses the model.

extra_data.drafting_priority: Assign separate roles to each reference

primary_recommendation: Seedance FLF2V mode: @Image1 = first frame, @Image2 = last frame. State explicitly that @Image2 is the final visual target so the model interpolates toward it.
rationale: FLF2V (first-last-frame-to-video) drives the clip from a defined start and end frame; without naming @Image2 as the final target the endpoint is ambiguous.

extra_data.key_constraint: State @Image2 is the final visual target

primary_recommendation: Seedance Edit mode: @Video1 is the source clip; change only one layer. Preserve composition and timing of the original.
rationale: Edit mode alters a single layer of an existing clip; preserving composition and timing keeps the rest of the shot stable.

extra_data.drafting_priority: @Video1 is source clip; change one layer

primary_recommendation: Seedance Extend mode: continue from accepted footage only. Route to the continuation protocol (source-gated continuation; observed end-state overrides planned state).
rationale: Extend mode lengthens an accepted clip; the continuation protocol gates how many consecutive output-sourced generations are allowed before a canonical re-anchor is required.

primary_recommendation: Seedance 2.0 binds uploaded assets with @-mentions typed directly in the prompt: @Image1–@Image9 (CN @图片1–@图片9, max 9), @Video1–@Video3 (CN @视频1–@视频3, max 3), @Audio1–@Audio3 (CN @音频1–@音频3, max 3). Tags must be written exactly — do not translate, renumber, or rewrite as [Image1]; the @-parser silently fails on bracket form.
rationale: Reference tags are the binding mechanism between uploaded assets and prompt roles. The @-parser is literal; bracket form and renumbering break binding silently.

primary_recommendation: Before writing prompt prose, assign each reference asset a role. Image good roles: identity, product, pose, costume, environment, first frame, last frame (avoid asking it to define unseen motion). Video good roles: motion, camera, pacing, blocking, timing, gesture rhythm (avoid copying protected identity/logo/scene ownership). Audio good roles: rhythm, tempo, mood, ambience, delivery tone, music texture (avoid assuming voice/song/likeness authorization).
rationale: Explicit role assignment prevents the model from over-extending a reference (e.g. asking an image to define motion, or a video to copy protected identity).

image.avoid: asking it to define unseen motion

video.avoid: copying protected identity, logo, or scene ownership

audio.avoid: assuming voice, song, or likeness authorization

primary_recommendation: Seedance 2.0 enforces a source-gated continuation model: (1) observed state overrides planned state — if a generated clip ends differently from plan, the next prompt starts from the actual ending; (2) extension depth — consecutive output-sourced generations since last canonical re-anchor, default ≤2, hard ceiling ≤3, at cap must re-anchor from canonical references; (3) clip contract — already_happened / this_clip_only / reserved_for_later arrays constrain prompt scope; (4) canon revision — increments on every accepted take/deviation/re-anchor; project-state JSON is the single source of truth.
rationale: Critical for multi-shot sequences. Continuation gates prevent identity/geometry drift when generation deviates from plan, which is the norm for AI video.

rules: extension depth: consecutive output-sourced generations since last canonical re-anchor (default ≤2, hard ceiling ≤3)
clip contract: already_happened / this_clip_only / reserved_for_later arrays constrain prompt scope
canon revision increments on every accepted take / deviation / re-anchor

primary_recommendation: Each Seedance clip carries a clip contract with three arrays that constrain prompt scope: already_happened (events established in prior clips), this_clip_only (what this single clip must show), reserved_for_later (events explicitly held back for future clips).
rationale: The clip contract scopes the prompt so the model does not try to render future events or re-render past ones, keeping multi-shot continuity coherent. Schema: clip-contract.schema.json.

primary_recommendation: Shot Intent JSON (engine-agnostic, produced by P09, consumed by P11): felt_intent + visible_behavior + camera_intent {shot_size, movement, axis, endpoint} + lighting_intent {key_source, ratio, temperature} + audio_intent + continuity {already_happened, this_clip_only, reserved_for_later, locks}. felt_intent and visible_behavior are MANDATORY; the directing engine refuses emotion words (sad/tense) and requires visible gestures.
rationale: Layer 1 of the LTX→Seedance bridge (live since 2026-07-12). Survives engine swap — switching from LTX to Seedance = swapping only the Layer 2 adapter. P09ShotIntent + P09ShotItem Pydantic models validate it.

shot_intent.felt_intent: 观众感受到她意识到真相
shot_intent.visible_behavior: 她放下信，双手静止不动

primary_recommendation: P11 take_log entry (Seedance retake-protocol inspired): {take_n, shot_id, changed_variable, seed, verdict, evidence}. verdict ∈ keep / fix_in_post / edit / re_roll / rewrite. Rule: same flaw ≥2 takes → must rewrite prompt (not a third re-roll).
rationale: Layer-2/3 structured iteration tracking. Replaces blind 抽卡 (change seed and resubmit) with a five-verdict triage and attempt budget, saving GPU budget when the prompt is the actual problem. P11TakeLogEntry + P11VideoClip Pydantic models validate it.

primary_recommendation: P11 observed_end_state schema (Seedance canon rule — observed overrides planned): record {character_position, character_pose, camera_end_position, environment_state, open_motion_vectors} after generation acceptance. The next shot's prompt compilation reads observed_end_state of the parent, not the planned_end_state.
rationale: Seedance's core innovation: the next clip's prompt is compiled from the actual ending state of the accepted footage, not the planned state. Without this, multi-shot continuity breaks when generation deviates from plan. P11ObservedEndState validates it.

primary_recommendation: Pattern 1 — define the abstract prompt once (provider-agnostic), then write a thin adapter per model that maps abstract sections → model grammar. Swapping models = swapping adapters, not rewriting prompts (e.g. flux2_adapter maps identity/composition/lighting/mood to tagged form; veo2_adapter maps motion/identity/lighting/mood to descriptor-prefix form).
rationale: Decouples prompt intent from model grammar, so a model swap is an adapter-only change. This is the foundation that lets <image_primary>/<video_primary> placeholders stay abstract in SKILL.md.

primary_recommendation: Pattern 2 — all models in a pipeline share the same consistency_context.json (identity / style / composition carry). Only the per-call prompt grammar differs by model.
rationale: A single carry artifact keeps identity/style/composition stable across image and video calls while letting each model receive grammar-appropriate prompts.

primary_recommendation: Pattern 3 — if <image_primary> fails (OOM, timeout, quality < threshold), fall back to <image_fallback>. The abstract prompt stays the same; only the adapter swaps. Same for <video_primary> → <video_fallback>.
rationale: Fallback chains preserve the abstract prompt across primary/fallback model swaps, so a degraded model doesn't force a prompt rewrite.

primary_recommendation: LTX → Seedance field migration map (from P09 current output → Seedance equivalent): intent≈felt_intent; camera_movement≈camera_intent.movement; shot_type≈camera_intent.shot_size; axis_line≈camera_intent.axis; emotion→Seedance requires visible behavior instead; ltx_prompt is engine-specific (NOT reusable for Seedance); character_refs[{name,turnaround_path,role}]≈@Image1 controls identity; scene_ref≈@Image2 controls environment; style_prefix≈Seedance directorial voice; color_guidance(CxSxZ)≈Seedance lighting intent.
rationale: Migration map from ltx-seedance-migration-roadmap.md §1. Documents what changes when switching the dev/debug LTX engine to the production Seedance target, so dev and production converge. Note: this is a migration map, not a single model template.

primary_recommendation: Three-layer architecture (LTX→Seedance bridge, live 2026-07-12): Layer 1 Shot Intent (engine-agnostic, produced by P09 — felt_intent/visible_behavior/camera/lighting/audio/continuity); Layer 2 Engine Adapter (engine-specific — LTX adapter→ComfyUI workflow JSON, Seedance adapter→natural-language prompt + @Image/@Video role map); Layer 3 Surface Profile (platform-specific — LTX/ComfyUI resolution+sampler, Seedance API model_id+duration+reference upload slots).
rationale: Switching from LTX to Seedance = swapping the Layer 2 adapter only; Layer 1 Shot Intent stays constant. This is the architectural principle that makes the engine swap cheap.

primary_recommendation: Template instantiation workflow: (1) assemble abstract prompt from visual_intent + style_genome_5d + character_assets; (2) select model target (still→<image_primary>, motion→<video_primary>) by VRAM + latency budget; (3) apply model adapter (FLUX/Veo/Kling template); (4) load consistency_context (LoRA/IP-Adapter/InstantID + style vector + composition locks); (5) token budget check — if >4000 trigger prompt_overload fallback; (6) emit model_prompts.json.
rationale: Canonical 6-step workflow that turns intent into a model-ready prompt while staying under the 4000-token ceiling and preserving cross-call consistency.

primary_recommendation: Model swap protocol: (1) re-verify prompt grammar (structured tags vs natural language vs descriptor prefixes); (2) re-verify token counting (new tokenizer may count differently); (3) re-verify consistency refs (LoRA/IP-Adapter/InstantID may need re-training); (4) update verified_date stamp (stale templates must be re-verified quarterly); (5) update this ref with new model grammar + example.
rationale: Quarterly re-verification is mandatory — model versions change quarterly and prompt-token mappings drift. The verified_date stamp is load-bearing.

primary_recommendation: <1000 tokens: tight focus; all constraints honored. Production suitability Excellent (atomic shots).
rationale: Empirical attention degradation curve for stable_2026 horizons. Below 1000 tokens the model honors every constraint — ideal for atomic single-concern shots.

rationale: Standard shots live here. Minor tail dispersal is acceptable for typical identity+composition+lighting prompts.

primary_recommendation: 2500-4000 tokens: moderate dispersal; critical constraints still honored. Production suitability Acceptable (complex shots). This is the acceptability ceiling — above it prompt_overload fallback must trigger.
rationale: Complex multi-concern shots can use up to the 4000 ceiling, but dispersal is moderate. 4000 is the canonical prompt_token_efficiency ≤ 4000 criterion from 02-NODE-SPECS.md §2.7.

primary_recommendation: >6000 tokens: severe dispersal; many constraints ignored. prompt_overload fail mode — must decompose or re-anchor.
rationale: Hard fail territory. At this size the model ignores many constraints; escalate to intent-layer simplification (decompose into multiple calls with shared consistency_context).

primary_recommendation: Section 1 — Identity (character refs, wardrobe, posture): typical 80-200 tokens. Stability: stable (carry via system prompt).
rationale: Standard 5-section chunk. Identity is stable across calls in a scene, so it belongs in the system prompt (cached) rather than repeated per call.

primary_recommendation: Section 2 — Composition (framing, eye-line, DoF): typical 50-150 tokens. Stability: stable (carry via system prompt).
rationale: Composition conventions (axis locks, screen direction) are stable across a scene and should be carried, not repeated.

primary_recommendation: Section 3 — Motion (camera move, subject motion): typical 30-80 tokens. Stability: per-call variance.
rationale: Motion changes shot-to-shot, so it lives in the user prompt as per-call variance.

primary_recommendation: Section 4 — Lighting (key, fill, practicals): typical 50-120 tokens. Stability: per-call variance.
rationale: Lighting deltas (amber key vs blue key) change shot-to-shot; keep in the user prompt.

primary_recommendation: Section 5 — Mood (emotional tone, atmosphere): typical 30-80 tokens. Stability: per-call variance. Total standard 5-section chunk = 240-630 tokens, well under the 4000 ceiling.
rationale: Mood deltas change per call. The full 5-section chunk totals 240-630 tokens — well under ceiling.

primary_recommendation: <image_primary> (FLUX-class) provider context window ~512-1024 prompt tokens; effective prompt budget 512-1024. Tight — chunking mandatory for complex prompts.
rationale: Image models have the tightest window; complex prompts must be chunked to fit.

extra_data.note: Tight; chunking mandatory for complex prompts

primary_recommendation: <video_primary> (Veo-class) provider context window ~1024-4096 prompt tokens; effective prompt budget 1024-4000. Moderate — hierarchical prompts recommended.
rationale: Video models have a moderate window; hierarchical (system+user) prompts keep calls under the 4000 quality threshold.

primary_recommendation: LLM orchestrator (GPT-class) context window 128k+; effective prompt budget 4000 ceiling (self-imposed). The 4000 ceiling is a quality threshold, NOT a hard context-window limit.
rationale: Key insight: the 4000-token ceiling is NOT a context-window limit for most providers — it is an attention-quality threshold. Context window = max accepted length (hard provider limit); token budget = length at which output quality is still acceptable (soft quality threshold).

primary_recommendation: Flat prompt (everything in user prompt): typical user-prompt token count 800-2500, total call token count 800-2500.
rationale: Baseline for comparison against hierarchical prompts. No system-prompt caching benefit.

primary_recommendation: Hierarchical prompt (stable constraints in system prompt, variance in user prompt): user-prompt tokens 150-400, total call tokens 600-1500 (system cached). Cuts user-prompt token count by 60-80%, keeping every call well under the 4000 ceiling.
rationale: System prompt is cached by the provider (prefix-cache hit-rate optimization) and doesn't count against per-call variance budget. This is the most powerful token-budget strategy.

rationale: Carry-don't-repeat rule — the single biggest token-budget saving. Stable constraints live in consistency_context.json, not repeated in every user prompt.

rationale: The canonical 5-step fallback when token count exceeds the 4000 ceiling, before escalating to intent-layer decomposition.

primary_recommendation: Keep — when the primary spend is delivered and nothing fatal is present: lock, log, move on.
rationale: Five-verdict retake triage (Seedance). Keep is the accept verdict; do not iterate further on this take.

primary_recommendation: Re-roll — when the prompt is right but the sample was unlucky: same prompt, new seed (max 2-3 re-rolls).

primary_recommendation: Rewrite — when the same flaw appears ≥2 takes: diagnose, then change the prompt (not a third re-roll).

primary_recommendation: One-variable rule: change exactly one thing per retake — one prompt clause OR seed OR mode OR one reference. Never change multiple variables at once.
rationale: Governs all retake verdicts. Changing multiple variables per retake makes it impossible to isolate the cause of the flaw, defeating the triage.

rationale: IP-Adapter weight-tuning LUT. When wardrobe/lighting varies, identity is anchored by LoRA and the IP-Adapter reference supplies the variant.

primary_recommendation: IP-Adapter weight 0.30-0.45 for style transfer: light; style hint without dominating composition.
rationale: IP-Adapter weight-tuning LUT. Style transfer needs only a light touch so the style reference doesn't overpower composition.

extra_data.rationale: Light; style hint without dominating composition

primary_recommendation: InstantID weight 0.55-0.70 for close-up (face dominant): strong face lock; close-up amplifies identity drift.
rationale: InstantID weight-tuning LUT. Close-ups make identity drift most visible, so the face lock needs to be strongest here.

extra_data.rationale: Strong face lock; close-up amplifies identity drift

primary_recommendation: InstantID weight 0.45-0.60 for medium shot: moderate; face visible but not dominant.
rationale: InstantID weight-tuning LUT. In medium shots the face is visible but shares the frame, so a moderate lock suffices.

extra_data.rationale: Moderate; face visible but not dominant

primary_recommendation: InstantID weight 0.30-0.45 for wide shot: light; face is small in frame, less critical.
rationale: InstantID weight-tuning LUT. In wide shots the face is small, so identity drift is less visible and a light lock is enough.

extra_data.rationale: Light; face is small in frame, less critical

primary_recommendation: Identity embedding cosine similarity ≥ 0.92: grade A (excellent) — ship.
rationale: Identity drift detection LUT. Per-call identity embedding cosine similarity vs reference. The cross_call_consistency ≥ 0.85 criterion maps to grade B or above.

primary_recommendation: Identity embedding cosine similarity 0.85-0.92: grade B (acceptable) — ship; flag for review. This is the floor that satisfies cross_call_consistency ≥ 0.85.
rationale: Identity drift detection LUT. The canonical ≥ 0.85 success criterion maps exactly to the B/A boundary.

primary_recommendation: Identity embedding cosine similarity 0.75-0.85: grade C (marginal) — retry with stronger InstantID weight.
rationale: Identity drift detection LUT. Below the consistency criterion; strengthen identity lock and retry.

primary_recommendation: Identity embedding cosine similarity < 0.75: grade D (failed) — consistency_drift triggered; re-carry context + repeat key constraints verbatim in every call's system prompt.
rationale: Identity drift detection LUT. Hard fail; the consistency_context carry has been lost or mutated and must be explicitly re-carried.

extra_data.action: consistency_drift triggered; re-carry context + repeat constraints

primary_recommendation: Cross-shot drift threshold: for shot sequences, compute pairwise identity embedding cosine similarity between consecutive shots. Drift = consecutive-shot similarity < 0.85; drift indicates consistency_context carry failure.
rationale: Complements per-call grading by detecting drift ACROSS shots in a sequence, which signals a carry failure rather than a single-call identity problem.

primary_recommendation: ACE-Step 1.5 = 唯一支持人声歌词演唱(23 种语言)+ 长结构器乐配乐 + 风格重绘(Repainting)的引擎;模型 acestep_v1.5_xl_sft.safetensors(SFT 50步)/acestep_v1.5_turbo(8步),内置 Qwen 文本编码器(无需额外加载)
rationale: KAP 双引擎分工硬边界定稿(2026-08-06):人声/歌词/长配乐/Repainting 只有 ACE-Step 能做;纯 SFX/短氛围/内容 Inpainting 交给 SA3。文本编码器 Qwen 内置于模型,不像 SA3 需单独加载。

primary_recommendation: caption(音乐风格描述 max 4000)+ lyrics([Section] 标签 max 8000,默认 [Instrumental])+ instrumental(纯器乐)+ language(23 种)+ keyscale(35 种调性)+ timesignature(2/3/4/6/auto)+ bpm(0-300,0=自动)
rationale: ACE-Step 的核心音乐控制参数。[Section](Verse/Chorus/Bridge)标签是结构化长配乐的关键;keyscale 给出精确调性控制(SA3 无此能力)。

primary_recommendation: steps(1-200;SFT默认50/Turbo默认8)+ cfg(1-20,默认7.0)+ sampler_name(25种:euler/dpmpp_2m/lcm...)+ scheduler(normal/karras/sgm_uniform/simple...)+ infer_method(ode/sde)+ guidance_mode(apg/adg/standard_cfg)
rationale: Turbo 8 步用于快速预览(~1min),SFT 50 步用于高质量(~5-10min)。采样器/调度器与 ComfyUI 通用集对齐。

primary_recommendation: 风格重绘:repaint_enabled=true + repaint_mode=conservative/balanced/aggressive;基于源音频换风格保留结构。POST /api/v1/ace/comfyui/generate
rationale: ACE-Step 是唯一支持 Repainting(风格重绘)的引擎——改配器/情绪但保留旋律结构。SA3 无此能力。

primary_recommendation: format: mp3/wav/flac/opus/aac/wav32 + quality_preset: V0/64k/96k/128k/192k/320k
rationale: 输出格式比 SA3 多 opus/aac/wav32 三种;quality_preset 控制码率档。

primary_recommendation: POST /api/v1/ace/generate(异步 submit+poll,快速 text2music)+ POST /api/v1/ace/comfyui/generate(同步≤10min,全参数 repaint/cover/lego/complete/remix)+ GET /ace/status/:id(轮询)+ cancel/models/analyze
rationale: 两套 API:generate 异步适合批量任务,comfyui 同步全参数适合 Repainting 等复杂任务。ComfyUI 后端 :8188 用 AceStepSFTGenerate 节点。

primary_recommendation: Stable Audio 3 medium = 唯一支持 SFX 音效 + 内容 Inpainting + 短氛围 BGM(<60s LCM快)的引擎;模型 stable_audio_3_medium.safetensors(LCM 8步),文本编码器 T5Gemma(t5gemma_b_b_ul2.safetensors,独立加载)
rationale: SA3 的精确 SFX 控制 + Inpainting 是 ACE-Step 没有的;反过来 SA3 无人声/无歌词/无段落结构。⚠️ checkpoint 不含 CLIP,必须单独加载 T5Gemma;⚠️ 与 SageAttention 不兼容。

primary_recommendation: prompt(音频描述 max 4000)+ negative_prompt(默认 'low quality, distorted, noise')+ model(默认 stable_audio_3_medium.safetensors)+ text_encoder(默认 t5gemma_b_b_ul2.safetensors)
rationale: SA3 用 prompt 描述(无歌词概念),negative_prompt 默认排除低质量。无 keyscale/bpm 精确控制(仅靠 prompt 文本)。注意与 Stable Audio Open(旧开源版,foley sfx_prompt_pattern 来源)是不同型号。

primary_recommendation: seconds_total(1-380s,默认30)+ seconds_start(0-380,默认0,conditioning 起点)
rationale: 时长上限 380s;超过需分段生成 + 后期拼接。seconds_start 控制 conditioning 起点。注意 SA3 用 seconds_total 而 ACE-Step 用 duration。

primary_recommendation: SA3 prompt 分 4 类:Music(音乐片段)/Instrument(乐器独奏)/SFX(音效)/One-shot(单次音效如 gunshot)
rationale: 4 类 reprompt 是 SA3 SFX 提示词的规范格式;选错类别影响生成质量。这是 ACE-Step 没有的 SFX 精细分型。

primary_recommendation: steps(Medium LCM默认8/Base默认50,1-200)+ cfg(Medium LCM默认1/Base默认7,1-20)+ sampler(lcm/euler/dpmpp_2m/dpmpp_3m_sde)+ scheduler(simple默认)+ denoise(0-1.0,默认1.0;<1.0 启用 Inpainting)+ batch_size(1-16)
rationale: LCM 8 步 ~30s 出片(求快);denoise<1.0 + 加载源音频 = 局部内容重绘(Inpainting),保留未改区域。

primary_recommendation: POST /api/v1/stableaudio/generate(同步≤10min)+ GET /stableaudio/audio/:filename + models。⚠️ ComfyUI 拓扑必须含 ConditioningStableAudio 节点(修 EmptyLatentAudio latent rate bug);⚠️ SA3 与 SageAttention 不兼容
rationale: 两个硬约束:ConditioningStableAudio 节点缺失会算错 latent rate(Issue #14825/PR #14858);SageAttention 不兼容会导致推理异常。
source_section: §Stable Audio ComfyUI 节点拓扑/约束

primary_recommendation: 需要人声演唱歌词 → ACE-Step 1.5(唯一)。POST /api/v1/ace/generate,lyrics 带 [Section] 标签,vocal_language 指定语言
rationale: ACE-Step 是唯一支持 vocal + lyrics(23 种语言)的引擎。Stable Audio 无歌词/人声能力,严禁跨界使用。

primary_recommendation: SFX 音效 → Stable Audio 3 medium(唯一)。POST /api/v1/stableaudio/generate,prompt 用 4 类 reprompt 格式(Music/Instrument/SFX/One-shot)
rationale: SA3 精确 SFX 控制 + Inpainting 能力;ACE-Step 不适合短促音效,严禁跨界。

primary_recommendation: 纯器乐 BGM 且 < 60s → Stable Audio 3 medium(LCM 快速出片)。steps=8, cfg=1, sampler=lcm
rationale: SA3 LCM 8 步 ~30s 出片,适合短氛围段;ACE-Step 慢(~1-5min),短段不经济。

primary_recommendation: 纯器乐 BGM 且 > 60s → ACE-Step 1.5(instrumental=true,结构化长配乐)。POST /api/v1/ace/generate
rationale: ACE-Step 有结构化段落(Verse/Chorus/Bridge),长配乐连贯;SA3 无段落结构,长段松散。

primary_recommendation: 改内容(替换/续写某段) → Stable Audio 3 Inpainting。POST /api/v1/stableaudio/generate,denoise<1.0 + source_audio + inpaint_region 条件
rationale: SA3 通过 denoise<1.0 + 源音频实现局部重绘,保留未改区域;ACE-Step 无内容 Inpainting。

primary_recommendation: 改风格(换配器/情绪,保留结构) → ACE-Step 1.5 Repainting。POST /api/v1/ace/comfyui/generate,repaint_enabled=true,mode=conservative/balanced/aggressive
rationale: ACE-Step Repainting 基于源音频重绘风格保留结构;SA3 不支持风格重绘。

primary_recommendation: 默认:无明确匹配 → ACE-Step 1.5(最通用的音乐路径)。边界 case:歌曲改歌词段→ACE Repainting 两步;音效>380s→SA3 分段+拼接;60s 边界→优先 SA3(快);人声+音效→分轨(ACE 人声 + SA3 音效)+ mixer 混音
rationale: ACE-Step 是最通用的默认音乐生成路径。边界 case 处理避免单引擎力不能及时的死结;人声+音效必须分轨生成再混音。

edge_cases.音效>380s: SA3 最大 380s,分段生成 + 后期拼接
edge_cases.60s边界: 优先 SA3 求快;需段落结构则 ACE
edge_cases.人声+音效: 分轨:ACE 人声 + SA3 音效,mixer 混音

primary_recommendation: physics_precheck 是只读规则级预检(不改 shot_intent),在 visual_executor 生成前对每 shot 跑 19 项检查,输出 physics_precheck_report.json。可行性分级:OK(通过)/WARNING(有风险,Director 决定)/NG(必须修改或 Debate)
rationale: CineWeave Physics Validator 的不可替代性来自约束预判 + 能力边界对账;AI 视频场景下约束源变为'模型能力 + Mixamo + scene geometry'。规则级判定优先于 LLM 推理(30°/180°/LHD-RHD/Mixamo 覆盖是确定规则)。

levels.WARNING: 有风险,Director 决定接受或 Debate
levels.NG: 必须修改(回退 cinematographer)或触发 Debate

severity_routing.NG_and_AI_dimension: 必须修改(违反硬约束,无 Debate 必要)
severity_routing.WARNING: Director 决定接受或回 Debate

primary_recommendation: crane_up/crane_down 需垂直空间 ≥ 3m;室内 scene_type=interior 默认 vertical_clearance=2.4m(住宅)/3.0m(商业)。不满足 → NG,fix='改为 dolly_in 或 tilt_up'
rationale: 摇臂运镜受场景几何天花板约束;室内净空不足时摇臂无空间抬升,必须降级为不需要垂直净空的运镜。

extra_data.rule: crane_up/down needs vertical_clearance >= 3m

primary_recommendation: tracking/dolly 运镜的运动路径必须无遮挡(geometry_bed.obstacles[]);若 obstacles 与路径相交 → NG,fix='调整摄像机路径'
rationale: 跟拍/轨道运镜需要物理通畅的移动路径;路径上有障碍物则镜头无法执行,必须绕开或改运镜。

extra_data.rule: tracking/dolly path must not intersect obstacles
extra_data.fix_suggestion: 调整摄像机路径绕开障碍

primary_recommendation: pan_left/right 总角度 ≤ 90°(物理上限);> 90° → NG(防止'甩镜头'超出 AI 可生成范围)
rationale: 摇摄角度过大超出模型的稳定生成范围,易产生扭曲;90° 是可生成的安全上限。

extra_data.rule: pan angle <= 90 degrees total
extra_data.fix_suggestion: 拆为多段摇摄或改 cut

primary_recommendation: handheld 单段 ≤ 3s;> 3s → WARNING(可生成但 AI 视频易出现 motion sickness),建议拆段
rationale: 长手持运镜累积抖动会让模型生成眩晕/失真;3s 内可保持稳定,超出建议拆为多段。

extra_data.rule: handheld single segment <= 3s

primary_recommendation: 按 physics_state(driving-straight/driving-turn/stationary/walking/running/other)检查 Mixamo 推荐动作在该 scene type 下是否被支持(对照 P04 character_bible.motion_vocabulary);不支持 → WARNING
rationale: 角色动作必须落在 Mixamo 动画库覆盖范围内;动作库无对应资产则无法绑定,需换动作或换 scene。

extra_data.rule: physics_state must map to a Mixamo motion supported in this scene_type

primary_recommendation: LTX-2.3/即梦不支持复杂多人物交互(> 2 人物 + 接触动作);character_refs ≥ 3 且 physics_state 暗示交互(拥抱/握手) → WARNING,fix='拆为 OTS coverage(2 个 2-人物 shot)'
rationale: 当前 AI 视频模型对 3+ 人物接触式交互的生成质量差;拆为 2-人物 over-shoulder 覆盖可绕过限制。(与 multiperson_complex_interaction 同源,此项给 OTS 拆解方案)

extra_data.rule: >=3 characters + contact interaction not supported
extra_data.fix_suggestion: 拆为 OTS coverage(2 个 2-人物 shot)

primary_recommendation: shot 含 dialogue_lines 时标记 lip_sync_deferral(唇同步在 P11 后处理);physics_precheck 仅记录'此 shot 需后处理唇同步',不做判定
rationale: 唇同步是生成后的独立工序;预检阶段只需标记需后处理的 shot,避免遗漏。判定树见 ltx-msr-lip-sync-deferral-decision-tree。

extra_data.rule: dialogue present → flag for P11 lip-sync post-process

primary_recommendation: 跨 cut 时角色运动方向(L2R/R2L/Up/Down)必须延续;shot N 角色 L2R 则 shot N+1 必须延续 L2R(除非有 narrative motivation);违反 → NG,fix='反转 shot N+1 角度或加 insert shot 重置方向'
rationale: 动势方向不延续会破坏观众空间认知;180° 线之外的隐性'动势线'同样不能随意翻转。补充 continuity_auditor(它只查 face/wardrobe/color/object)。

extra_data.rule: screen direction (L2R/R2L/Up/Down) must carry over across cut unless narratively motivated
extra_data.fix_suggestion: 反转 shot N+1 角度或加 insert shot 重置方向

primary_recommendation: shot N 与 shot N+1 的 camera_move motion_intensity 差距 > 0.5(0.0-1.0 标度) → WARNING(避免节奏跳跃)
rationale: 相邻镜头运动强度跳变过大会造成节奏断裂;0.5 是可接受的连续过渡阈值。供 editor 在 cut on action 时参考。

extra_data.rule: motion_intensity delta between adjacent shots <= 0.5

primary_recommendation: shot N 的 action_beat(per E-Konte Layer 3)与 shot N+1 必须能在 cut 点匹配(同动作不同角度);不匹配 → NG
rationale: 动作剪辑(cut on action)要求两个镜头在切换瞬间动作连续可拼;action_beat 不对齐会让动作看起来断裂/重复。

extra_data.rule: action_beat must match at cut point (same action, different angle)

primary_recommendation: scene_type=driving 时 ltx_prompt 必须显式声明 LHD('left-hand drive, steering wheel on the left side',大陆默认)或 RHD('right-hand drive, steering wheel on the right side',HK/海外);缺失 → NG
rationale: Volvo V2 教训:不声明时模型默认 RHD,与大陆左舵车矛盾导致方向盘位置错误。必须显式声明。

extra_data.rule: driving shots must declare LHD or RHD
extra_data.lhd_phrase: left-hand drive, steering wheel on the left side
extra_data.rhd_phrase: right-hand drive, steering wheel on the right side
extra_data.fix_suggestion: Add 'left-hand drive, steering wheel on the left side' to ltx_prompt

primary_recommendation: ltx_prompt 中'车从 X→Y 运动'的方向必须与 LHD 声明一致(driver 在左 → 默认 L2R);不一致 → NG
rationale: 左舵车驾驶员在左侧,车辆行驶方向与座驾位置有约定关系;方向声明与 LHD 矛盾会产生空间错乱。

extra_data.rule: vehicle motion direction must agree with LHD/RHD declaration

primary_recommendation: ltx_prompt 中出现 'glovebox' / 'rearview mirror' 等 speculative 部件名 → NG,fix='改用 lower dashboard area 等通用空间语言'
rationale: Volvo S5-4 教训:speculative(臆测性)部件名会让模型生成不存在的部件;用通用空间描述代替精确部件名更安全。

extra_data.rule: no speculative car part names in prompt
extra_data.fix_suggestion: 改用 'lower dashboard area' 等通用空间语言

primary_recommendation: LTX/即梦均不支持 360° orbit;camera_move=orbit 且 motion_intensity ≥ 0.7 → 直接 NG
rationale: 360° 环绕超出当前 AI 视频模型的生成能力,强行生成会失败或严重扭曲;是硬约束。

extra_data.rule: 360° orbit not supported

primary_recommendation: LTX/即梦不支持复杂多人物交互;多人物接触动作场景 → WARNING(能力边界警告)。
rationale: AI 能力硬边界:模型对复杂多人物交互生成不可靠。此条是能力边界声明;具体拆解方案见 multiperson_interaction_limit。

extra_data.rule: complex multiperson interaction not supported

primary_recommendation: 单 shot duration_sec > 15s → 直接 NG(hard ceiling)
rationale: AI 视频单镜头生成有硬性时长上限;超 15s 单镜头不可生成,必须拆段。

extra_data.rule: single shot duration <= 15s

primary_recommendation: 单 shot duration_sec > 8s 必须有 narrative_justification;缺 → WARNING(可生成但有质量风险)
rationale: 8-15s 区间可生成但偏离最佳时长;必须有叙事理由(per duration-decision-framework),否则建议拆短。

extra_data.rule: duration>8s requires narrative_justification

primary_recommendation: shot 的 starting_image 必须包含或暗示叙事主体(角色/人物);若 screenplay.characters 为空且 shot 是 Hook/Opening → NG,fix='加入叙事主体或调整 shot 类型';其他情况 → WARNING
rationale: Volvo S1-1 教训:空场景/无叙事主体的首帧会导致观众无落点,Hook 镜头尤其致命。首帧必须有主体。

extra_data.rule: starting_image must contain/imply a narrative subject
extra_data.trigger_ng: characters empty AND shot is Hook/Opening
extra_data.fix_suggestion: 加入叙事主体或调整 shot 类型

primary_recommendation: ltx_prompt 必须包含 6 维:motion state / character position / key props-wardrobe / camera role / spatial context / prop identity;缺任何一维 → WARNING(可生成但质量风险)
rationale: LTX Prompt Precision 7 维 + R11 铁律:维度不全的 prompt 生成质量下降;6 维是最低覆盖要求。

extra_data.rule: ltx_prompt must cover 6 precision dimensions

primary_recommendation: narrative_props = 直接推进剧情的道具(信件 / 钥匙 / 武器 / 契约)。每件必须有 narrative_role,装饰即 NG
rationale: 叙事道具是情节齿轮,观众需追踪其存在与状态;没有 narrative_role 的道具是噪声,违反 production_designer '道具必须有叙事动机' 铁律。

extra_data.rule: 必须有 narrative_role,装饰=NG

primary_recommendation: character_props = 凸显角色个性的道具(角色书桌上有什么 / 随身物件),通过物件选择刻画人物
rationale: 物件即角色:一个角色的随身/桌面道具应折射其职业、性格、阶层;统一的角色道具集维持人物识别度。

primary_recommendation: environmental_props = 营造氛围/质感的道具(落叶 / 灰尘 / 光斑),不叙事但定调
rationale: 氛围道具填充场景真实感与情绪底色;它们不推进剧情但决定'这个空间的感觉',与 visual_director 的光照/色彩配合。

primary_recommendation: motif_props = recurring visual motif 道具,必须通过 visual_motif_link 关联 visual_director 注册的 motif,不能独立创建
rationale: 母题道具承载跨 shot/scene 的视觉呼应(如'祖母的照片');production_designer 只决定它在哪些 shot 以什么位置/显隐度出现,母题本身归 visual_director 注册。独立创建 motif 违反职责边界。

extra_data.rule: 必须关联 visual_director 注册,不可独立创建

primary_recommendation: era_defining_props = 时代标记道具(1970s 翻盖电话/老式电视;2025 smartphone)。时代错位(1975 剧本出现 iPhone)→ NG
rationale: 时代道具锚定故事时空;时代错位破坏可信度。production_designer 需对照 screenplay 暗示的时代 vs 实际道具做时代错位检查。

extra_data.anachronism_rule: 时代错位=NG(如 1975 出现 iPhone)

primary_recommendation: culture_defining_props = 文化标记道具(中式婚礼:红色喜字/龙凤烛;西式:花球)。跨文化混用(中式婚礼出现西式花球)→ WARNING(可融合但需 narrative motivation)
rationale: 文化道具传递地域/族群身份;随意混搭削弱文化特异性,但有意融合(需叙事理由)可接受。

primary_recommendation: Chekhov 道具生命周期 LOAD→HOLD→FIRE→DEFLATE:LOAD(背景 defocused,S1)→HOLD(可见不变,S2-S3)→FIRE(成叙事中心揭示真义,S4)→DEFLATE(失力退为背景噪音,S5)。单场地弧线中尤其关键(观众有时间注意背景物)
rationale: 静态环境中背景物会被注意到,故 Chekhov 元素必须跨 shot 追踪生命周期。同一道具的 narrative function 随弧线三层转变:prop identity(是什么)→ narrative function(意味着什么)→ lighting state(当前光照下如何呈现)。不可逆证据道具(Icarus 弧线下降段)必须贯穿全程不变位置,仅 narrative function + screen_position 递减。

irreversible_evidence.rule: Icarus 下降段一个道具须贯穿全程不变位置
irreversible_evidence.position: 如 desk_surface_face_down 跨 10 shot 不变
irreversible_evidence.function_shift: 美丽毁灭(S3)→犯罪证据(S4)→永久后果(S5)

primary_recommendation: 道具位置双重编码:screen quadrant(9 宫格,供 cinematographer/visual_executor)+ 3D spatial position(scene-relative,供 physics_precheck/blender)。可见性蒙版:visible(应出现)/occluded(不应出现但场景存在,防穿帮)/excluded(场景不存在)
rationale: 双编码让摄影层(2D 画面位置)与物理层(3D 场景坐标)各取所需;可见性蒙版防穿帮(occluded 道具意外入镜)。camera forbidden zones 必须基于 P08 geometry_bed,不能凭空创造。

visibility_mask.occluded: 不应出现但场景存在(防穿帮)

extra_data.forbidden_zone_rule: camera_forbidden_zones 必须基于 P08 geometry_bed,不可凭空创造

primary_recommendation: 车内场景(scene_type=interior_car/driving)必须声明 driving_orientation:LHD(中国大陆默认,方向盘左)或 RHD(HK/海外)。缺失 → NG。声明须写入 ltx_prompt('left-hand drive, steering wheel on the left side')
rationale: Volvo V2 教训:不声明时模型默认 RHD,与大陆左舵车矛盾导致方向盘位置错误。production_designer 决定环境约束(LHD/RHD),供 physics_precheck 的 lhd_rhd_declaration 检查消费。

extra_data.lhd_phrase: left-hand drive, steering wheel on the left side

primary_recommendation: era 约束:声明 year/era label(1975/2025/qing_dynasty),配时代道具白名单。时代错位(1975 剧本出现 iPhone)→ NG
rationale: 时代一致性是可信度基石;production_designer 标记 screenplay 暗示的时代 vs 实际道具冲突,与 era_defining_props 配合做时代错位检查。

primary_recommendation: culture 约束:声明文化域(mainland_china/hong_kong/western/korean/japanese),配文化道具白名单。跨文化混用(中式婚礼出现西式花球)→ WARNING(可融合但需 narrative motivation)
rationale: 文化道具传递地域身份;production_designer 维护文化白名单,有意融合需叙事理由否则标记。

primary_recommendation: scene_geometry_type 分类:interior / exterior / interior_car / exterior_urban / exterior_nature。触发对应 environment_constraint 检查(车内→LHD/RHD;特定场景→可见部件白名单)
rationale: 场景类型决定哪些约束适用;production_designer 据 scene_description 分类 scene_type,继承 P08 geometry_bed(vertical_clearance/obstacles),再标注 per-shot camera_forbidden/recommended_zones 供 physics_precheck 消费。

primary_recommendation: 禁止 speculative parts:ltx_prompt/production_design 不可出现 'glovebox'/'rearview mirror' 等模型会幻觉的部件名 → NG,改用 'lower dashboard area' 等通用空间语言
rationale: Volvo S5-4 教训:speculative(臆测性)部件名让模型生成不存在的部件并拉伸画面;用通用空间描述代替精确部件名更安全。production_designer 决定可见部件白名单。
source_section: §Environment Constraint Declaration + §Prop Placement Rules + What NOT to do

extra_data.rule: no speculative part names
extra_data.fix: 改用 'lower dashboard area' 等通用空间语言

primary_recommendation: 同一 scene 内环境状态必须一致:道具状态(打开/关闭/满/空)、光线状态(昼/夜/黄昏)、天气(晴/雨/雾)跨 shot 不变,除非有 narrative motivation(时间跳转)。输出 environment_continuity_baseline.json 供 continuity_auditor 审计
rationale: 环境穿帮(shot N 白天 / N+1 夜晚)破坏连续性;production_designer 建场景级 baseline 锁定一致字段,continuity_auditor 据此审计。冲突定义:shot N forbidden zones 与 N+1 visible props 矛盾。

primary_recommendation: 单场地动态光照弧线:维护 lighting state registry(warm_teal/crimson_rim/fluorescent_white),光照转换帧(transition)必须在 environment_notes 显式追踪前后两态(如 'lighting_instant_transition_crimson_to_fluorescent_white')。desk-as-enclosure:下降序列中大型家具(桌沿)跨 shot 升至面部之上制造'下沉',无需角色移动
rationale: 单场地无场景切换时,光照状态转换是叙事弧线的主载体。transition 帧最关键须双态追踪。环境状态一致性(SKILL §113)已包含光线状态,故光照态归环境约束。desk-as-enclosure 用固定道具+体态变化制造下沉错觉,免 3D rig。

states.crimson_rim: S2 催化,假警/英雄决意
states.fluorescent_white: S4 现实崩塌,暴露/审判

extra_data.transition_rule: transition 帧须在 environment_notes 双态追踪

desk_as_enclosure.technique: 桌沿跨 shot 升至面部之上
desk_as_enclosure.progression_example: S5 下巴→嘴→鼻→眉(仅剩抽搐眼睛)
desk_as_enclosure.benefit: 固定道具+体态变化,免 3D rig

primary_recommendation: 渐进式空间揭示遵循 5 拍:Surface(仅表层,隐藏层严格不可见)→Foreshadow(植入一条潜意识微纹理提示)→Transition(层 N 揭示,层 N-1 成'搁浅异常残留')→Reveal Frame(所有层同时可见,峰值帧)→Post-Reveal(全层已知,身份解码)
rationale: 观众初期认知的空间(如'手术室')在中后期被揭示为另一空间(如'水族馆')。固定拍结构保证揭示节奏可控、回调连贯。验证于 ep-otter-doctor-v2(2层 12-shot)与 ep-hamster-demolition(4层 5-scene)。

beats.Surface: Hook/setup,仅表层,隐藏层严格不可见
beats.Foreshadow: Rising,植入一条潜意识细节(注塑纹理/异常反光),首看像正常
beats.Transition: Reversal,层 N 揭示,层 N-1 成搁浅残留,角色认知冻结
beats.Reveal_Frame: Climax,所有层同时可见,最高置信帧 0.93-0.95
beats.Post_Reveal: Ending,全层已知,身份符号解码,存在性放弃

primary_recommendation: 层转换时前层道具不可消失,须作'搁浅异常残留'(stranded remnant)保留——脱语境、常缩小,作回声标记。如 ep-hamster-demolition S4 微缩玩具屋内仍可见混凝土碎块
rationale: 前层道具凭空消失会被 continuity_auditor 标记穿帮;保留为搁浅残留既维持连续性又强化揭示冲击。这是揭示场景跨 shot 连续性的关键。

extra_data.rule: prior-layer props do not vanish; remain as stranded remnants
examples: ep-hamster-demolition S4: 混凝土碎块仍在微缩玩具屋内
ep-hamster-demolition S3: 金墙面板重标为'实验室反射镜'
extra_data.downstream: continuity_auditor 会标记无解释消失

primary_recommendation: 揭示场景每个 shot 的 production_design 必须含 space_identity_note 字符串字段,追踪当前揭示态(如 'primary_layer=surgical_room, hidden_layer=aquarium_tank (not yet revealed)');TRANSITION 与 REVEAL_FRAME shot 须显式标注
rationale: 空间身份逐步揭示需逐 shot 显式追踪揭示状态;space_identity_note 是揭示场景最核心的字段,让下游 visual_executor 知道哪些隐藏层元素该出现/隐藏。

format_examples.Surface: primary_layer=X, hidden_layer=Y (not yet revealed, strictly invisible)

primary_recommendation: 揭示场景须维护 Prop-State Tracking Table(continuity_anchors):每个跨 shot 变化的道具逐 shot 追踪物理状态。出现 3+ shot 的回调道具须有一行;只出现 1-2 shot 的不必,除非状态变化承重
rationale: 揭示场景道具状态变化频繁(如石头:干燥→沾汁液→裂纹;手术服:干净→湿透→干硬壳),不逐 shot 追踪会穿帮。这是揭示场景最重要的连续性工件。

extra_data.rule: 回调道具(3+ shot)须一行

primary_recommendation: 揭示帧的情感载荷依赖材质纹理对比(toy/plastic 层 vs real/organic 层)。production_designer 须在 environment_notes 声明材质对比(如 'real_fur_texture_vs_plastic_toy_vertical_contrast')。production_designer 拥有'可见什么材质',visual_director 拥有'材质什么色/光'
rationale: 材质对比本身就是揭示的视觉载体(上层光泽有机毛皮 vs 下层哑光塑料);不声明则丢失揭示的情感冲击。职责边界:材质归 production_designer,色光归 visual_director。

examples: ep-hamster-demolition S4: real_fur vs plastic_toy 垂直对比
ep-otter-doctor-v2: 手术钢精密 vs 水族馆玻璃/水流动

primary_recommendation: 揭示涉及尺度反转(看似大的实为更大容器中的微小物):pre-reveal 不可有矛盾尺度线索;揭示帧所有前层道具同时缩小(声明 within_toy_set 缩小 vs cage_reality 全尺寸);尺度反转道具以 narrative_role:'scale_inversion_*' 标记
rationale: 尺度反转是揭示的强力手法(玩具屋→真实仓鼠笼);production_designer 须确保揭示前无破绽线索,揭示帧正确声明哪些道具缩小、哪些是全尺寸新元素,供 visual_executor 区分。

extra_data.technique: scale inversion (large-seeming is tiny inside larger container)
rules: 揭示帧前层道具同时缩小

primary_recommendation: 揭示场景置信度校准:Surface 0.90-0.92 / Foreshadow 0.88-0.90 / Transition 0.85-0.88(最低,双层共存+残留管理最复杂)/ Reveal Frame 0.93-0.95(最高,所有元素已知)/ Post-Reveal 0.90-0.93
rationale: 揭示各拍复杂度不同,Transition 最难(双层共存+残留管理)置信最低,Reveal Frame 最清晰置信最高。校准置信度帮下游决策哪些 shot 需更仔细生成/审校。

primary_recommendation: hard_cut(硬切)= 两 shot 直接拼接无转场效果。默认转场:动作驱动剪辑(cut on action)/节奏需要/压缩时空不示意转换时用。叙事片 >80% 的 cut 是硬切
rationale: 零成本零 GPU:后期 ffmpeg concat,无生成开销。最透明不分散注意力,适合动作/节奏驱动的切换。

extra_data.engine_routing: ffmpeg concat(P12),无 GLM 成本无 GPU
extra_data.when: 默认转场/cut on action/节奏驱动/压缩时空

primary_recommendation: dissolve(叠化)= 出镜渐隐+入镜渐显同步重叠。示意时间流逝/地点转换;暗示情感或主题关联;柔化突兀 cut;闪回/梦境转场
rationale: 后期 ffmpeg xfade=fade(12-24帧@24fps),无生成成本。叠化是'时间/空间已变'的经典信号,比硬切更柔和。

extra_data.when: 时间流逝/地点转换/情感主题关联/闪回梦境

primary_recommendation: wipe(擦除)= 几何边界扫过画面替换出镜。变体:left/right/iris(圆形)/clock/diagonal。风格化或喜剧转场;强场景/段落切换;致敬古典好莱坞(1930s-50s)
rationale: 后期 ffmpeg xfade=wipeleft/wiperight(24-36帧)。风格化强,适合明确的段落边界或喜剧 smash-cut 效果。

extra_data.when: 风格化/喜剧/强段落切换/古典致敬

primary_recommendation: fade(淡入淡出)= 与纯色(通常黑)过渡。fade-in(黑→像)/fade-out(像→黑)/fade-through-black。用于重大场景/幕边界、影片首尾、重大时空或叙事转换、情感标点(死亡/揭示)
rationale: 后期 ffmpeg xfade=fade(24-48帧,带黑板)。fade 是最强的'段落终结'信号,用于 act break / 影片首尾。

extra_data.when: act break/影片首尾/重大转换/情感标点

primary_recommendation: match_cut_shared_object(共有物匹配)= 出镜中某物件/形状匹配入镜中对应物,视觉韵律跨 cut。跨场景/地点视觉连续;暗示主题或象征关联;创造流动感
rationale: 混合路径:生成时 Wan2.2 14B FLF2V(本地 ~21GB VRAM)做跨 shot 共有物;后期 ffmpeg cut on action 兜底。最著名的 match cut(《2001 太空漫游》骨头→卫星)即此类。与 axis_compliance.matchcut_type 区别:此处是创意意图转场,matchcut_type 是连续性匹配审计。

extra_data.engine_routing: Wan2.2 14B FLF2V(local ~21GB VRAM) primary;ffmpeg manual cut on action fallback
extra_data.when: 跨场景视觉连续/主题象征关联/流动感

primary_recommendation: match_cut_shared_landscape(共有景观匹配)= 出入镜的整体景观/构图/取景匹配(即使具体物件不同)。构图韵律跨 cut 桥接地理/时间遥远场景;主题平行;梦境诗意转场
rationale: 混合路径:生成时 Hailuo 02 i2v Pro 或 Vidu keyframe-to-video(云引擎,中文内容);ffmpeg 兜底。构图(而非物件)的匹配更诗意。

extra_data.engine_routing: Hailuo 02 i2v Pro(cloud,MINIMAX_API_KEY) primary;Vidu keyframe-to-video(cloud,VIDU_API_KEY) secondary;ffmpeg fallback
extra_data.when: 构图韵律桥接遥远场景/主题平行/梦境诗意

rationale: 混合路径:生成时 Hailuo/Vidu 云引擎(运动矢量生成是云原生强项);ffmpeg motion-based cut 兜底。动作戏维持动感动能的关键手法。

rationale: 后期 ffmpeg 调色(primary LUT + grade match)。色彩(而非物件/运动)的匹配,适合诗意色彩弧线。

primary_recommendation: j_cut(J 剪)= 音频主导转场:入镜音频在视觉 cut 前 0.3-0.8s 开始。观众先听到下一场景再看到,制造预期。建预期/张力;音频自然领先场景桥接(先听敲门再切到门);暗示角色心理(先听到再反应)
rationale: 后期 ffmpeg audio lead。J 形(音频/视频轨排列)得名。声音先行制造悬念与预期,是对白/惊悚片常用手法。

primary_recommendation: l_cut(L 剪)= 视频主导转场:视觉 cut 在音频 cut 前 0.2-0.5s。观众看到下一 shot 时仍听到出镜音频,营造重叠连续感。对话场景平滑过渡;情感重量延续(reaction shot);时间重叠感
rationale: 后期 ffmpeg visual lead。L 形得名。对白驱动剧情的标准剪辑实践,音频余韵延续情感。

extra_data.engine_routing: ffmpeg visual lead(0.2-0.5s before audio cut)
extra_data.when: 对话平滑过渡/情感延续/reaction shot/时间重叠

primary_recommendation: whip_pan(甩摇)= 极快摇摄制造运动模糊作转场:shot A 末尾模糊遮 cut 到 shot B(从半程甩摇开始并稳定)。营造单镜头连续运动错觉桥接两场景。能量转场(动作/喜剧);伪装 cut(long-take 错觉);Edgar Wright 标志风
rationale: 混合路径:ffmpeg whippan 模拟兜底——AI 生成当前不可靠(per TRANS-08 延期至 v15+)。运动模糊遮 cut 是隐藏剪辑的经典手法。

primary_recommendation: none(无转场)= 显式标记 shot 无到下一 shot 的转场——直接拼接,连 hard_cut 标记也无。用于 next_shot_link 为 null(序列末 shot)或开发期占位
rationale: 后期 ffmpeg 直接 concat,无转场处理。用于显式声明'此处无转场逻辑'(末 shot 或占位),区别于 hard_cut(有意的拼接)。

primary_recommendation: Face 维度:ArcFace/FaceNet cosine similarity ≥ 0.80 跨 shot 同角色一致;失败 → re-generate shot(within-scene zero tolerance,必须 1:1 一致)
rationale: 跨 shot 角色脸不一致是 AI 视频最显眼的穿帮;ArcFace/FaceNet 余弦相似度是身份一致性的标准度量。Within-scene 零容忍(同场景同 character 必须 1:1),cross-scene 允许 lighting/angle 变化但 face ID 须一致,cross-episode 允许 wardrobe arc 变化但 face ID 仍一致。

scope_tolerance.cross_scene: face ID 一致,允许 lighting/angle
scope_tolerance.cross_episode: face ID 一致,允许 wardrobe arc

primary_recommendation: Wardrobe 维度:CLIP image embedding cosine ≥ 0.95 且 color histogram Bhattacharyya ≤ 0.10;失败 → re-generate shot(within-scene zero tolerance)
rationale: 服装穿帮(同场景服装变化)破坏连续性;CLIP 语义嵌入 + 色彩直方图双重度量兼顾款式与颜色。Bhattacharyya 距离衡量色彩直方图相似度(越小越似)。

extra_data.metric: CLIP image embedding cosine + color histogram Bhattacharyya
extra_data.handoff: drawer + production (re-generate with wardrobe baseline reference)

primary_recommendation: Color 维度:ΔE2000 / CIELAB 距离 ≤ 5.0(production)/ ≤ 8.0(preview);失败 → colorist re-grade
rationale: 跨 shot 色彩漂移破坏场景统一;ΔE2000 是 CIELAB 色差标准度量。Production 容差更严(5.0)因大银幕/付费观众敏感,preview 放宽(8.0)。失败交给 colorist 重调而非重生(色彩是后期可修)。

primary_recommendation: Object 维度:Object detection IoU ≥ 0.70 且 CLIP object embedding cosine ≥ 0.90;失败 → re-generate 或 prop swap(within-scene zero tolerance)
rationale: 关键道具跨 shot 不一致(如某道具突然消失/变形)是穿帮;IoU 衡量物体定位一致性,CLIP 衡量物体语义一致。失败可重生或换道具。

extra_data.metric: Object detection IoU + CLIP object embedding

primary_recommendation: 审计范围严格度:Within-scene(极严格,face/wardrobe/object 零容忍,同 character 1:1)> Cross-scene 同 episode(严格,face ID + wardrobe baseline 一致,允许 lighting/angle 变化)> Cross-episode(中等,face ID 一致,允许 wardrobe arc 变化)
rationale: 严格度随范围递减:同一场景内任何不一致都是硬伤;跨场景允许合理的光线角度变化;跨集允许角色成长导致的服装弧线变化(per wardrobe-per-scene §Arc wardrobe)。

levels.cross_scene: 严格,face ID + wardrobe baseline 一致
levels.cross_episode: 中等,face ID 一致,允许 wardrobe arc

primary_recommendation: 审计时序:Per-shot(生成后立即 4 维 audit)→ Per-scene 完成(within-scene 一致性)→ Per-episode 完成(cross-scene + cross-episode)→ Pre-distribution(全量最终 audit + compliance_review)。不可只在 final distribution audit
rationale: 穿帮越早发现修复成本越低;逐级审计(per-shot→scene→episode→distribution)形成闭环。仅在 final distribution audit 是 anti-pattern(发现时已无法低成本修)。

primary_recommendation: 失败 handoff:Face→drawer+production(re-train LoRA 或调 IP-Adapter weight);Wardrobe→drawer+production(wardrobe baseline reference 重生);Color→colorist(re-grade);Object→drawer+scene_builder(重生或 prop swap)
rationale: 不同维度失败需不同专家修复:身份(脸)问题改 LoRA/IP-Adapter,服装问题用 baseline reference 重生,色彩问题后期重调,物件问题重生或换道具。标准化 handoff 避免误派。

routing.wardrobe: drawer + production → wardrobe baseline reference 重生
routing.object: drawer + scene_builder → 重生或 prop swap

primary_recommendation: 5 大 anti-pattern 规避:① 凭肉眼无自动化 audit→4-metric 自动化;② within-scene 允许 face ID drift→zero tolerance;③ cross-episode face ID drift 未处理→cross-episode audit;④ 无 audit_report 文件→audit_report.json per scene;⑤ 仅 final distribution audit→per-shot+per-scene+per-episode
rationale: 这些是连续性审计最常见失败模式;每条都有明确 mitigation。audit_report.json 是可追溯的审计工件(per scene 必出)。

rationale: Chion 5 种 sound-image 关系之一。同步声是最基础的音画关系,建立场景真实感与物理 grounding。Joy/Hope 情绪推荐 empirical + rendered。

rationale: Chion:声音不仅同步,更能'增值'——赋予画面原本没有的含义。沉默配面部特写让观众读出内心独白。Sadness/Loss 推荐用 adding value(沉默+face)。

primary_recommendation: Acousmatic(幻听)= 听到声音但看不到声源(画外音/隐藏 source)。用于 mystery/悬疑。设计:声音持续 2-5s 后再 reveal source 建张力;+ close-up reaction shot 是经典组合
rationale: Chion 借用 Schaeffer 的 acousmatic 概念——声源不可见制造悬念。声音越具体(revealed source 越易猜)效果越弱。Anticipation/Fear 推荐用 acousmatic。隐藏 boss 画外音、monster footsteps unseen、钥匙开门声先于门开都是经典用例。

primary_recommendation: Silence 是设计选择(非 music/SFX 缺席):Tension silence(重要 beat 前 1-2s 静默建预期)/Emotional silence(失去悲伤的静默=adding value)/Diegetic silence(真空/耳聋 special effect)。短剧 silence ≤3s,后必须跟强 hook/drop/climax,不可连续(dead air=观众流失)
rationale: Chion 强调 silence 是一种 audio-vision mode。静默是强力设计工具但短剧场景风险高(观众上滑):须短(≤3s)、紧跟高潮、不连续。

primary_recommendation: emotion × audio-vision mode 推荐:Anticipation→Acousmatic(build-up);Fear/Tension→Acousmatic+Psycho-analytic;Sadness/Loss→Adding value(沉默+face);Joy/Hope→Empirical+Rendered;Anger→Empirical+Adding value;Surprise→Acousmatic+Rendered
rationale: 情绪与音画模式有天然适配关系;错用模式(如 joy 场景用 acousmatic)是 audio-vision anti-pattern。每 scene 须 specify audio-vision mode(per Chion 协议)。

rationale: 三者分工明确,但'某 scene 用哪种音画模式'的顶层分配归 composer。避免 music 过响盖 dialogue(mixer ducking)等 anti-pattern。

primary_recommendation: 16:9 横屏 power points(标准 rule of thirds):(1/3,1/3)/(2/3,1/3) 上线(站姿 eye-line);(1/3,2/3)/(2/3,2/3) 下线(body/prop);golden ratio 交点(~0.382,~0.618)供更动态平衡。与竖屏 9:16 (1/3,1/4) 显著不同——不可直接套用
rationale: 横屏 cinema/TV 观看距离 3-5m(vs 竖屏 mobile 25-30cm),标准 rule-of-thirds 提供足够视觉兴趣分布;16:9 水平宽度是视觉叙事主轴,主体沿水平线移动;(1/3,2/3) 线为 two-shot 提供自然主体分布。PITFALL F-1:16:9 ≠ 'resize 9:16'。

primary_recommendation: 横屏 headroom 普遍大于竖屏:EWS/WS 10-15%、MS/FS 8-12%、MCU 6-10%、CU 5-8%、BCU 3-5%。Eye-line 放画面 vertical 1/3 from top(upper rule-of-thirds 线),适用 WS→CU 所有景别
rationale: 横屏水平宽度充足+观看距离远+lead room 需求,故 headroom 大于竖屏(8-15% vs 5-10%)。Eye-line at 1/3 from top 是横屏 framing 的 foundational rule。

extra_data.eyeline_rule: vertical 1/3 from top, 适用 WS→CU

primary_recommendation: Lead room (nose room)——横屏独有:profile shot(侧面)须给主体面部朝向方向留 15-25% 空间。面朝右→右侧 15-25%;面朝左→左侧 15-25%。不足则'face pressed against edge' anti-pattern(观众 claustrophobic)
rationale: 横屏水平宽度支持主体朝向留白;profile shot 的视线前方留白是叙事承载(孤立/沉思)。竖屏无此概念因水平宽度受限。

extra_data.rule: profile shot 朝向方向留 15-25%

primary_recommendation: 16:9 字幕 safe area 3 区:Top(0-10%,平台 logo/标题,禁字幕)/Center action(10-80%,主体 action,禁字幕除非 lower-third)/Bottom(80-100%,推荐字幕区)。横屏字幕优先 Bottom zone(80-95%)
rationale: 基于 broadcast safe area + platform UI 研究;Bottom zone 避开 action 与平台 UI。Lower-third(画面下方 1/3)是 broadcast 标准位置。

primary_recommendation: 横屏字幕 per-platform divergence(1920×1080):Cinema DCP 最大(36-48px,SMPTE)> Netflix 24-32(90%)> 抖音横屏 24-32(82%)≈ YouTube 22-30(85%)≈ B站 20-28(85%)。字体:Netflix Sans/思源黑体/Roboto;色:白+黑描边
rationale: 大银幕(Cinema)字幕须最大(SMPTE 36-48px);mobile 横屏(抖音)即使横屏也距离近故偏小。Netflix Timed Text Style Guide 规定 bottom 90% + 行长 ≤42 CPL + sans-serif。

primary_recommendation: 横屏 platform framing 5 大 divergence:YouTube(cinematic+retention curve,前5-10s hook)/B站(容忍长 establishing)/抖音横屏(5-10s hook+快 ramp,mobile-first)/Netflix(full cinematic+production value)/Cinema DCP(full cinematic+大银幕,EWS/WS 占比高,CU≤20%)
rationale: 各平台受众与观看环境不同:付费流媒体期望 cinema-quality;大银幕放大 framing 缺陷故 EWS/WS 多、CU 少;mobile-first 平台需快 hook。YouTube retention curve 要求前 5-10s 有 hook 之后可 cinematic。

divergence.Cinema_DCP: full cinematic+大银幕(EWS/WS 高占比,CU<=20%)

primary_recommendation: 横屏 framing 6 大 anti-pattern:① 套竖屏 power points(1/3,1/4)→强制(1/3,1/3);② headroom<8%→WS/MS≥8%/EWS≥10%;③ profile shot 无 lead room→15-25%;④ vertical tilt 滥用作 primary→优先 pan/tracking/steadicam;⑤ Cinema/Netflix CU 过载(大银幕不适)→CU≤20%;⑥ YouTube/抖音开场 slow establishing→前5-10s MCU/CU hook

primary_recommendation: 先把压抑写具体且持续，再在不可退让点集中爆发，不要用一句“他终于怒了”替代积累。
rationale:
压抑蓄力爆发的关键是限制持续累加，让读者和主角一起憋，再在一个不能再退的节点一次性兑现。
压抑段要有真实损失和无法立刻反击的理由，爆发段则必须改写关系、局面或规则，不能只是情绪大声量。

primary_recommendation: 先给读者一个“已经结束”的错觉，再用新信息或更高层级结果完成补刀。
rationale:
微反转补刀适合放在爽点兑现后半拍，用假结束制造松弛，再用更狠的一手把情绪再抬一格。
这类节拍最怕提前透完牌，因此前段只兑现主目标，后段再揭开隐藏收益、额外代价或对方更惨的后果。

primary_recommendation: 先统计最近二十到五十章的爽点、信息量、钩子和情绪曲线，再决定删减还是补强。
rationale:
中后期节奏诊断不能只凭感觉，至少要同时看爽点密度、信息量、章末钩子和情绪曲线四个维度。
如果留存下降，优先判断是爽点重复、信息拖延、钩子失效还是情绪长期平直，再对症调整章节任务。

primary_recommendation: 按铺垫、爆发、余韵三段排布情绪，不要把最狠的话和最大动作一口气全扔完。
rationale:
高情绪场景需要有起压、爆点和余韵，读者才会感到情绪真的经过了积累、决裂和回响。
铺垫段负责点燃问题，爆发段击中不可调和点，余韵段通过沉默或动作让关系变化真正落地。

primary_recommendation: 每一层反派都要对应不同压力来源和损失类型，避免只是把同一种敌人换成更高数值。
rationale:
反派体系要拆成试探、压制、改局、终局四类压力，让对手升级不仅更强，还能改变主角的代价和决策难度。
小反派负责引战和暴露短板，中层反派负责切资源与人脉，高层反派负责改规则或改地图，终极反派才承担价值观对决；若所有对手只会靠战力叠数值，读者很快会麻木。

primary_recommendation: 先确认原始冲突和角色动机，再用催化事件、多方入局、峰值爆点三段加码，不能凭空硬拐。

最稳的做法不是一句更狠的台词，而是引入新证据、新参与方或公开场合，让私下矛盾变成关系、利益、体面一起失控；升级后还要留下余波，不然只剩吵闹。

发现型、危险型、揭露型都能用，但必须建立在本章已推进的基础上，不能靠无意义断句硬卡。

最稳的做法是提三到五个关键变化，再把下一卷的敌人、地图或真相点到即止，而不是把整卷复述一遍。
